title: 7.3 – Demons
description: What are demons, and who is Satan? These and other related questions are covered in this episode.
speaker: Platt

title: 7.2 – Angels
description: What are angels, and what role do they play in the purposes of God? These and other questions concerning Scripture's teaching on angels are covered in this episode.
speaker: Platt

title: 7.1 – Foundational Truths about Spiritual Warfare
description: It's important that our understanding and engagement in spiritual warfare is grounded in the teaching of Scripture. In this first episode, David Platt lays some biblical foundations for understanding this important biblical theme.
speaker: Platt

title: 6.10 – The Effects of the Cross
description: In this final episode David Platt considers the effects of Christ's death by identifying seven reasons why we can boast in the cross.
speaker: Platt

title: 6.9 – The Intent of the Cross
description: This episode considers the intent of the cross by answering the question "For whom did Christ die?"
speaker: Platt

title: 6.8 – The Declaration of Triumph
description: In this episode we consider the good news of Christ's dying yet triumphal words––"It is finished." He has accomplished our redemption.
speaker: Platt

title: 6.7 – The Cry of Dereliction
description: "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?" In this episode we consider what these mysterious words reveal about Christ's death on the cross. The curse due sinners was born by the Sinless One.
speaker: Platt

title: 6.6 – The Garden of Gethsemane
description: This episode examines Christ's death from the perspective of His words in the Garden of Gethsemane. Through Christ had no sin, He bore God's wrath in our place. The cross testifies to Christ's willingness to do His Father's will.
speaker: Platt

title: 6.5 – The Last Supper
description: The Last Supper vividly portrays Christ's death as the fulfillment of God's redeeming work in Israel's history. The Passover, the Day of Atonement, and the entire Old Covenant point us to Christ's sacrificial death on the cross.
speaker: Platt

title: 6.4 – Divine Substitution
description: The only way for God's divine justice to be satisfied was through a divine substitute. In this episode we'll see that Christ, who was fully God and fully man, was the only sufficient sacrifice for sinners.
speaker: Platt

title: 6.3 – Divine Satisfaction
description: While the cross certainly meets our greatest need, it is first and foremost the way in which God meets His own righteous standard. In this episode we consider how Christ's death fully satisfies God's righteousness and justice.
speaker: Platt

title: 6.2 – The History of the Cross
description: How does the cross save us? Many answers have been given to that question throughout history, though not all of them have been biblical. In this episode we'll look at the various theories that have been used to explain how the cross provides salvation. It's only through the lens of Scripture that we can rightly consider the various dimensions of Christ's atoning work.
speaker: Platt

title: 6.1 – The Cross of Christ
description: There is no Christianity apart from the cross of Christ, for it is the lifeblood of everything we believe. In this first episode, David Platt introduces us to the centrality of the cross as well as the timeline of events that led up to his final hour on earth. Our faith, as well as all of history, revolves around the death of the Son of God.
speaker: Platt

title: 5.10 – The Work of the Spirit for the Glory of God
description: The Holy Spirit gives us the gifts to make the glory of God known throughout the entire world. In this final episode of Secret Church 5, David Platt concludes that the Spirit will complete His sanctifying work in and through His people.  Download the study guide to follow along with this episode  here .
speaker: Platt

title: 5.9 – The Filling and Gifts of the Spirit
description: We should regularly seek to be filled with the Spirit and to use the gifts of the Spirit for the building up of the church. But many Christians continue to ask, Are all of the Spirit's gifts––including healing, tongues, etc.––still available today, and should we seek them?  Download the study guide to follow along with this episode  here .
speaker: Platt

title: 5.8 – Significant Issues: Blasphemy of the Holy and the Baptism of the Holy Spirit
description: What does Scripture say about the unpardonable sin? Should we be looking for a second baptism, a baptism of the Spirit? In this episode David Platt answers these questions by looking at some relevant Scripture passages.   Download the study guide to follow along with this episode  here .
speaker: Platt

title: 5.7 – The Holy Spirit Guides the Will of God in Our Lives
description: How can I know God's will for my life? Many Christians struggle to answer that question. However, we are not called to understand the secret will of God but rather to believe and obey His revealed will. According to Scripture, we are saved by the Spirit, filled by the Spirit, and submissive to the Spirit. Obeying what we do know helps us gain the godly wisdom and perspective needed to make decisions in areas that are less clear.  Download the study guide to follow along with this episode  here .
speaker: Platt

title: 5.6 – The Spirit's Work in the Church
description: In this episode David explains how the Spirit works in the church through individual believers. If we are going to rely on the work of the Spirit, we must first understand how Scripture defines His work.   Download the study guide to follow along with this episode  here .
speaker: Platt

title: 5.5 – The Spirit in the Church
description: Following the coming of the Spirit at Pentecost, we see His work in and through the early church. This same Spirit is at work in the church today, opening the eyes of our hearts and enabling us to turn from sin and trust in Christ. Have you been born again by God's Spirit?  Download the study guide to follow along with this episode  here .
speaker: Platt

title: 5.4 – The Work of the Holy Spirit Throughout Scripture
description: The Holy Spirit is fully God and has therefore existed eternally. We see His work in the Old Testament among God's people, Israel, and in the New Testament through Christ and His people. We see the Spirit's work in the book of Acts as the gospel spreads to the ends of earth, overcoming opposition and unbelief.   Download the study guide to follow along with this episode  here .
speaker: Platt

title: 5.3 – The Holy Spirit in Action
description: Scripture is clear that the Spirit acts according to His own power and authority. In this episode we'll what else Scripture says about the attributes and works of the Spirit.    Download the study guide to follow along with this episode  here .
speaker: Platt

title: 5.2 – The Holy Spirit: Mystery and History
description: Why do Christians see the Holy Spirit as mysterious? In this session David Platt answers this question with some foundational truths about the Holy Spirit. Historically, there have been various movements that have shaped the church's view of the Holy Spirit. But the most important question is, Which view is rooted in Scripture?
speaker: Platt

title: 5.1 – Exploring the Holy Spirit
description: As believers we have been given the Holy Spirit, but many of us rely on ourselves rather than being desperate for the Spirit's help. So how does the Spirit equip us to grow in holiness? David Platt sets the stage for Secret Church 5 by introducing us to questions like these that will be answered in the upcoming episodes.
speaker: Platt

title: 4.11 – God and Evil
description: If God is good and in control, then how can there be evil in the world? In this episode, David Platt concludes Secret Church 4 by answering this question through the lens of Scripture.
speaker: Platt

title: 4.10 – God Has a Plan
description: What does it mean for God to be sovereign over all things? Can humans be responsible over anything on the earth if God is in charge? In this episode, David Platt explains the intersection between the sovereignty of God and the responsibility of man.
speaker: Platt

title: 4.9 – The Mysteries of God
description: What makes a mystery a mystery to the human race? As Christians should we be able to resolve the mystery of the gospel? In this episode, David Platt teaches on the trinity and the soverign will of God through the lens of Scripture.
speaker: Platt

title: 4.8 – The Goodness of God
description: In this episode, David Platt analyzes seven attributes of God that point to His goodness. As believers we must understand His goodness so that we will be zealous for God's glory and our good in all of the earth.
speaker: Platt

title: 4.7 – The Omnipresence, Omniscience, and Immutibility of God
description: In this session, David Platt explains how we are never alone as believers—God is always present. In times of confusion, God has all knowledge and widsom at all times. We can trust in these promises because God's perfections are unchanging.
speaker: Platt

title: 4.6 – How and Why God Exists
description: This question exists over all of creation: "Where did God come from?" God is not a force to be reckoned with or an object to be manipulated. God is a person to be loved for all of eternity.
speaker: Platt

title: 4.5 – The Great God is Our Father
description: The God who created life on Earth came to be from nothing. The greatness of God can be found throughout the story of creation. This same God has not left us in the dark but allows us to know his perfect attributes.
speaker: Platt

title: 4.4 – El Shaddai, Jehovah, and Father
description: David Platt continues to explain how the names of God display the glory of God. The God who sits enthoned upon all glory still allows the children of God to call Him Father.
speaker: Platt

title: 4.3 – Elohim, Yahweh, Jehovah, Adonai, and El Elyon
description: In this episode, David Platt begins to analyze the different names of God that we read throughout the Bible. David explains how these names were a refuge for the people of that day and for generations to come.
speaker: Platt

title: 4.2 – Knowing and Obeying God
description: Knowing God should lead to obeying God. The knowledge of the names of God alone leads the people of God to worship and obey the revelation of God.
speaker: Platt

title: 4.1 — How We Can Know God
description: God is incomprehensible, so how could we ever fully understand every single thing about Him? Becasue of our sin, we are hindered from glimpsing the fullness of God. Though we cannot understand God fully, we can understand God truly.
speaker: Platt

title: 3.10 – Putting It into Practice, Part 3
description: David Platt finishes an overview of how to study different genres of Scripture, giving specific examples and opportunities to practice from Old Testament Poetry, Prophecy, Wisdom Literature, and finally Revelation.
speaker: Platt

title: 3.9 – Putting It into Practice, Part 2
description: David Platt continues an overview of how to study different genres of Scripture, giving specific examples and opportunities to practice from the Old Testament Narratives and the Law.
speaker: Platt

title: 3.8 – Putting It into Practice, Part 1
description: David Platt continues an overview of how to study different genres of Scripture, giving specific examples and opportunities to practice from the Gospels, the Parables, and Acts.
speaker: Platt

title: 3.7 – Applying Scripture to Our Lives
description: After you observe, understand, and relate the text, you then must learn to apply it responsibly. First, you meditate on the truth, then relate it to today, and finally practice it. The episode ends by moving into how to use these methods across Scripture as a whole, specifically noting different genres and how they affect our study, starting with the New Testament letters.
speaker: Platt

title: 3.6 – Considering the Context
description: In studying God's Word, we must honor the way and time in which God chose to communicate. This book wasn't written just for us; it was written for His people throughout history. We must understand God's Word in this way to understand its meaning for us today.
speaker: Platt

title: 3.5 – From Exploration to Interpretation
description: In this episode, David Platt finishes walking through step 1 in the practical approach to Bible study and transitions to step 2: Understand their home (What does it mean?). Another way to put it, we move from exploration to interpretation of the text.
speaker: Platt

title: 3.4 – Observing the Home and Taking Note of What You See
description: After overviewing a guide to a dependable approach to Bible study, David Platt walks through each step using specific examples from Scripture, beginning with step 1: Observe their home (What do I see?).
speaker: Platt

title: 3.3 – A Dependable Approach to Bible Study
description: Four practical steps to approaching Bible study can be compared to going on a mission trip: Observe their home (What do I see?), Understand their home (What does it mean?), Bring it back home (How does it relate?), and Apply it in your home (What do I do?).
speaker: Platt

title: 3.2 – How to and How Not to Study the Bible
description: The Spirit-inspired Word of God is alive today. This means that we must approach the Word carefully to discern its true meaning.
speaker: Platt

title: 3.1 – Defining the Bible
description: The Bible, though written by multiple authors, was ultimately written by one divine Author to you and me. These 66 books of ancient history are relevant to each of our lives today.
speaker: Platt

title: 2.11 – Kingdom Advancement and Kingdom Anticipation
description: The New Testament only make sense in the context of mission. If the church does not advance the kingdom of God, we cannot understand His Word. His kingdom does not exist for us; we exist for it. And we hope in the kingdom that is to come. Are you advancing His kingdom, and are you anticipating it?
speaker: Platt

title: 2.10 – The King's Plan Unfolding
description: God has a plan, and His plan cannot be stopped. Will the church align with her King's plan? If we resist, we miss the whole point of why we're here. The point is that God would be glorified in a community of people from every tribe, nation, and language. The church is the living representation of the kingdom of God on the earth today.
speaker: Platt

title: 2.9 – The Gospel Accepted and the Mission Enacted
description: Jesus came to proclaim the kingdom of God as both a present reality and a future glory. Have you accepted this gift of the kingdom? As we submit to Christ's lordship in our lives, we submit to His sovereignty over all.
speaker: Platt

title: 2.8 – The King's Proclamation and Authority
description: When Jesus came, what was His message? Central to His message was, "Repent." And by the way He lived, He demonstrated the power of the kingdom. The King has come, and He has conquered.
speaker: Platt

title: 2.7 – The King's Introduction
description: The whole Bible points to Jesus. So who was He? The fading shadow of the Kingdom of God in the Old Testament has been illuminated by the glorious revelation of Christ in the New Testament.
speaker: Platt

title: 2.6 – The Letters of the New Testament – Part 4, and the Overall Purpose
description: David Platt finishes teaching through the New Testament letters, specifically 2 Peter–Revelation, and leads into an introduction of God's purpose for giving us the New Testament and its implications for His people even today.
speaker: Platt

title: 2.5 – The Letters of the New Testament – Part 3
description: The New Testament contains letters written by Paul and "general letters" written by others. David Platt continues to teach through the New Testament with more of these letters, specifically 1 Timothy–1 Peter.
speaker: Platt

title: 2.4 – The Letters of the New Testament – Part 2
description: David Platt continues to teach through the New Testament with more of Paul's letters, specifically 1 Corinthians–2 Thessalonians.
speaker: Platt

title: 2.3 – The Letters of the New Testament – Part 1
description: The book of Romans—one of Paul's letters—gives us a clear explanation of the gospel and is key to us understanding the purpose for and message of the New Testament.
speaker: Platt

title: 2.1 – Overview of the New Testament
description: What books make up the New Testament? How was it compiled? While the New Testament was divinely inspired by the Holy Spirit, it is also both a literary and historical work. To understand the New Testament, it is important, also, to understand it in its literary and historical context.
speaker: Platt

title: 1.8 - A Survey of the Old Testament
description: David Platt surveys the Old Testament to explain that God brings His people to His place for His purpose.

description: God displays his mercy on the wicked people of Nineveh who believed God and repented of their sins.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,201 – A Cry for Salvation (Jonah 2:6)
description: When Jonah is in the belly of the whale, he calls out to God and cries out for salvation.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,200 – Obeying God's Calling on Our Life (Jonah 1:1–3)
description: When God clearly calls Jonah to bring the gospel to unreached people, he turns and runs away from God's call.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,199 – The Day of the Lord is Near (Obadiah 1:15)
description: The day of judgment is coming and only those who believe the gospel will be saved.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,198 – Enjoying God and His People (Amos 9:13–15)
description: Those who trust in God will spend eternity enjoying God and his people.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,197 – The Worst Kind of Famine (Amos 8:11–12)
description: As horrible as a famine with no food is, a famine of God's Word is even more devastating.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,196 – Boldness to Proclaim the Word (Amos 7:12–13)
description: As Christians, we should pray for those who face persecution to boldly proclaim the word of God.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,195 – Seek Me and Live (Amos 5:4)
description: Those who seek after God will live. Those who do not will face eternal judgment.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,194 – The God of Creation (Amos 4:13)
description: God has created the mountains and the wind and he has authority over everything.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,193 – Caring for the Afflicted (Amos 2:6–7)
description: God, rather than seeking after our own financial gain, may our desire be to obey you and care for those who are poor and needy.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,192 – The Reign of Justice (Amos 1:3)
description: We long for the day when justice reigns over the nations.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,191 – Judgment Will Come (Joel 3:14)
description: The day of the Lord is near and judgment will come to all people.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,190 –  Returning to God (Joel 2:12–13)
description: When we fall short of the glory of God, we ought to return to God in repentance.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,189 –  The Role of Fasting (Joel 1:14)
description: While fasting is not a significant part of many Christians' spiritual lives, the Scripture seems to assume that we will regularly fast.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,188 – Sin is Spiritual Adultery (Hosea 14:9)
description: The price for sin is death, yet God is merciful to those who turn and trust in Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,187 – Salvation is Found in God Alone (Hosea 13:4)
description: Salvation cannot be found in ideas, people, or theories. Salvation is only found in God.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,186 – The Compassion of God (Hosea 11:8-9)
description: God has been incredibly compassionate with us despite our sin and the wrath we deserve.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,185 – Do You Fear God? (Hosea 10:3)
description: Those who do not fear God do not honor God. We must ask ourselves if we truly fear God.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,184 –  Our Security is Found in God Alone (Hosea 8:14)
description: Instead of looking to the economy or politics to find security and hope, we must look to God to provide us with eternal security.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,183 –  Praying on Election Day (Matthew 6:9–10)
description: We pray that God's name would be exalted and feared on Election Day.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,182 – Avoid Sin by Living by Faith (Romans 14:23)
description: We choose to fight our sin through the obedience of faith.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,181 – Do Justice, Love Kindness, and Walk Humbly (Micah 6:8)
description: The lives of God's people should be marked by kindness, humility, and justice.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,180 – A Light to the World (Matthew 5:14–16)
description: Rather than getting caught up in the divisiveness of the world, the church should be a light that points to Jesus.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,179 –  Spirit-Filled Unity (Romans 15:1–7)
description: Rather than pleasing ourselves, we ought to look to build each other up.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,178 – The Centrality of the Great Commission (Matthew 28:18–20)
description: During a presidential election, we must not lose sight of the most urgent calling: to share the gospel with others.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,177 – Fear God and Honor the Government (1 Peter 2:13–17)
description: God has not called us to worship those in leadership positions, but to worship God while we obey and submit to the governmental leaders.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,176 – The Unity of the Spirit (Ephesians 4:1–6)
description: Rather than falling into the toxicity of the political climate we live in, we ought to maintain the unity of the Spirit in the church.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,175 – Sojourners and Exiles (Philippians 3:20–21)
description: We are called to live as foreigners, those who abstain from the sinful desires of this world.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,174 –  God is Worthy of Our Hearts (Mark 12:13–17)
description: No political leader or party is worthy of our hope and trust. Only Jesus is worthy of our hearts.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,173 –  Save Us from Dishonorable Passions (Romans 1:18–32)
description: Rather than being overcome by sinful desires, we should seek salvation from them.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,172 –  Working for the Good of the City (Jeremiah 29:7)
description: God commands his people to seek the welfare of the city, even when they are in exile.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,171 –  Praying for Wise Leaders (Proverbs 2:9–15)
description: Wise leaders are marked by a fear of God and a discernment between good and evil.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,170 –  He is the Lord of All (Psalm 82:1–8)
description: May we remember that God is the ruler over all the kings and presidents of this world.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,169 –  Just and Righteous Leaders (Psalm 72:1–7)
description: God, please provide us with leaders who are known for their love for justice and for the oppressed.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,168 – The Sovereignty of God in Elections (Proverbs 21:1)
description: God has sovereignly chosen leaders to serve for the good of his people.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,167 –  Leaders Marked by Humility (1 Kings 3:5–14)
description: Rather than leading according to their own ideas, we pray for leaders who are marked by humility.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,166 –  God is Our King (Judges 17:6)
description: Instead of looking to God as the ruler and king, the people looked to themselves as king.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,165 –  Choose This Day Whom You Will Serve (Joshua 24:14–15)
description: We must decide if we will serve God or ourselves.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,164 –  Fear God by Keeping His Law (Deuteronomy 17:14–20)
description: When we fear God, we respond in obedience.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,163 –  Justice Ordained by God (Exodus 18:21–23)
description: From the beginning, God has ordained a process to promote justice among His people.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,162 –  Seek the Things Above (Colossians 3:1–17)
description: As we seek after the Lord, may the words of Colossians 3 be true of our lives.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,161 – God's Word is Wisdom (James 1:5–8)
description: Allow God's word to guide each and every decision.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,160 – A Supreme and Selfless Love (Matthew 22:37–40)
description: Would a surpreme love for God and a selfless love for others steward the way that we interact with the world.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,159 – A United People (John 17:20–24)
description: Father, we pray that you would unify your people as you are united with your Son and Spirit.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,158 – Called as Witnesses (Acts 1:8)
description: The people of God have been called to witness to something far greater than partisan politics. We have been called to share the gospel of Jesus Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,157 – A Different Gospel (Galatians 1:6–10)
description: Rather than prioritizing political opinions over the gospel, we should keep the gospel at the center of it all.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,156 – The Role of Government (Romans 13:1–4)
description: The biblical role of government is to promote good and protect from evil.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,155 – Crowned with Glory and Honor (Psalm 8:5–8)
description: The majestic Ruler of creation has crowned humanity in glory and honor.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,154 – Image Bearers of God (Genesis 1:26–28)
description: In the midst of such a divisive season, we must remember that each and every person has been created in the image of God.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,153 – Kingship Belongs to the Lord (Psalm 22:27–28)
description: Even during an election season full of uncertainty, we should remember that God is king.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,152 – Every Good Thing Comes from God (Ezekiel 31:9–11)
description: All good things are evidence of God's goodness. It is He who makes things beautiful.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,151 – Living in Holiness and Godliness (Ezekiel 30:3)
description: The day of judgment is coming and it will be a day of gloom for those who do not know the Lord. May God help us to live holy and godly lives in light of this reality.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,150 – They Shall Know that I am the Lord (Ezekiel 29:6)
description: When we look at the world around us, we should know that God is working to make His name known.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,149 – The Root of All Sin (Ezekiel 28:1–2)
description: At the root of all of our sin and rebellion is pride.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,148 – Don't Put Your Trust in the World (Ezekiel 27:27)
description: God has ordained government, military, and economy for the good of his people. We do not put our trust in the world, but in God.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,147 –  Nations Come and Fall (Ezekiel 26:17–18)
description: At the sovereign decree of God, even the strongest nations can fall.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,146 – Death is Not the End of the Story (Ezekiel 24:15–18)
description: We thank you, God, that, if we are in you, our story does not end in death.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,145 – Help Us to Obey (Ezekiel 23:49)
description: God's ways are right and good. We pray that God would give us the power to obey His commands.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,144 – Care for the Sojourner (Ezekiel 22:6–7)
description: Throughout Scripture, God commands the people of God to care for those in need around us.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,143 – Crying Out for Salvation (Ezekiel 21:6)
description: Our hearts should break for those who do not know Jesus because we know that judgment is coming.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,142 –  For the Sake of His Name (Ezekiel 20:9)
description: The whole point of our lives is to glorify the name of God.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,141 – Practicing Lament Well (Ezekiel 19:1)
description: God doesn’t ask us to ignore the sin and suffering around us. Instead, he invites us to call on him in sorrow and lament.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,140 – Standing Before the Judge (Ezekiel 18:30-32)
description: God is calling his people to repent from their sin because everyone will eventually stand before the Judge.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,139 – God's Sovereignty on Display (Ezekiel 17:24)
description: God is in control of all things. From the trees of the forest to the depths of our heart, God has authority over it all.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,138 – The Everlasting Covenant (Ezekiel 16:59-60)
description: Despite the sinfulness of God's people, God remembers the everlasting promises that he has made to them.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,137 – Turn, Repent, and Believe the Gospel (Ezekiel 14:6)
description: The central message of the Bible is that God has called his people to turn away from their sin and turn toward God.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,136 – Knowing What the Lord Says (Ezekiel 13:6)
description: When we hear people declare "thus saith the Lord," we ought to compare what they say to God's Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,135 – Urgency for the Gospel (Ezekiel 12:26-28)
description: Rather than believe that we have unlimited time, we should have an urgency for people to hear, respond, and believe in the gospel.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,134 – The Promise of a New Covenant (Ezekiel 11:18-20)
description: Ezekiel points us toward a new covenant where God, through Jesus Christ, does what we could not do.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,133 – God is Always with Us (Ezekiel 10:18)
description: God's presence will never leave us. Because of Jesus, we can commune with God at any moment.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,132 – God's Heart Toward Sin (Ezekiel 9:4)
description: Rather than minimizing temptation and sin, may we have the same heart that God has toward evil.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,131 – Behold the Glory of God (Ezekiel 8:4)
description: When we see the glory of God and love the purity of God, it will lead us to hate our sin against Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,130 –  The Day of Judgment is Coming (Ezekiel 7:10)
description: In light of the realization that the day of judgment is coming, we ought to live in order to point people towards Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,129 – A Sobering Picture of Judgment (Ezekiel 6:10)
description: The Scriptures show a serious picture of judgment, but this judgment is not in vain. In the midst of hardship, God has a unique purpose for discipline.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,128 – Bring Us to Repentance (Ezekiel 5:5-6)
description: Rather than living our lives sinfully as the world does, we should pray for God to bring us to repentance.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,127 – Demonstrate God's Word in Your Life (Ezekiel 4:4-8)
description: As Ezekiel demonstrated the specific words of God in his life, we have been called to live our lives according to God's Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,126 – God's Call to Repent (Ezekiel 3:16-19)
description: God has called his people to serve as watchmen over the souls of others. We have a responsibility to warn people of judgment and point them toward repentance.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,125 – Rest Trustfully in the Lord (Isaiah 40:28)
description: When we remind ourselves of the character of God, we are led towards trust-filled rest and hope-filled confidence.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,124 – Live as Those Who Have Been Sent (Ezekiel 2:3)
description: As the Father sent Jesus to the earth, God has chosen to send us to the nations.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,123 – The Likeness of the Glory of the Lord (Ezekiel 1:28)
description: When God's glory is described or seen, it leads to awe. The appearance of the likeness of God leads us to worship.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,122 – Live with Your Identity in Christ (John 21:20)
description: We praise You, O God, for giving us an identity that lasts forever. Help everyone listening to see themselves as disciples loved by Jesus.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,121 – The Hope of the Resurrection (John 20:11–16)
description: Take comfort, Christian. If you have been united with Christ in a death like His, then you shall certainly be united with Him in a resurrection like His.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,120 – It is Finished (John 19:30)
description: Jesus has accomplished our salvation through His finished work on the cross. May we be faithful to proclaim this good news.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,119 – My Kingdom is not of this World (John 18:36)
description: Thanks be to God that through Christ we have been welcomed into a kingdom not of this world.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,118 – Praying for Oneness in the Church (John 17:20–24)
description: We pray that the church will be united as one just as the Father, the Son, and the Spirit are one.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,117 – The Spirit Will Lead Us into Truth (John 16:13–15)
description: We want to know God more and more. May our only boast be in the Lord.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,116 – Abide in Me (John 15:5)
description: Our primary responsibility is to abide in Jesus. Lord, help us to abide in You.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,115 – In Jesus' Name We Pray (John 14:13–14)
description: "Whatever you ask in my name, this I will do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son. If you ask me anything in my name, I will do it."
speaker: Platt

title: #1,114 – Stooping to Serve (John 13:14)
description: "If I then, Your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another's feet."
speaker: Platt

title: #1,113 – To Live, You Must Die (John 12:24)
description: Father, help us to die to ourselves and to sin today. May we live not for our own glory but for Yours.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,112 – Trusting Him in Trials (John 11:37)
description: In the midst of suffering and trials, let's trust in the God who has defeated death and promises a day when we will be with Him free from sin and suffering.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,111 – Jesus is Your Good Shepherd (John 10:14)
description: Take comfort that you are not alone. The Good Shepherd has laid down His life for you and promises to be with you always. In Christ, you are fully known and fully loved.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,110 – I was Blind, now I See (John 9:25)
description: Lord, bring about the miracle of John 9 in the lives of many through our testifying to the saving work of Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,109 – The Truth Will Set You Free (John 8:31–32)
description: We need the Lord's help to see abiding in His Word as the key to experiencing freedom.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,108 – Speaking with His Authority  (John 7:16)
description: Lord, give us grace to proclaim Your Word. May we humbly submit to Your authority and teach others to obey all that You have commanded.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,107 – You have the Words of Eternal Life (John 6:66–69)
description: Lord, keep us from being like the crowds in John 6. May we follow the true Jesus according to His Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,106 – Jesus is Our Life (John 5:19)
description: Lord, help us to do nothing of our own accord, but may we live today with our identity in Christ for Your glory.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,105 – Lift up Your Eyes and See  (John 4:35)
description: Lord, open our eyes to the fields white for harvest all around us. Help us to be diligent to contend for the faith.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,104 – He Must Increase, but I Must Decrease (John 3:30)
description: Lord, You alone are worthy of all worship and praise. Help us to live with a constant refrain in our hearts, "He must increase, but I must decrease."
speaker: Platt

title: #1,103 – Consumed by the Glory of God (John 2:16–17)
description: What consumes you? So often we can be consumed by things other than the glory of God. Lord, help us to live with zeal for Your glory.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,102 – Full of Grace and Truth (John 1:14)
description: We rejoice that Christ came to us full of grace and truth to seek and save the lost. Lord, make us to be a people full of grace and truth.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,101 – The Global Gospel of God (Luke 24:45–47)
description: Lord, we ask for grace to see the centrality of the nations in the gospel of Jesus Christ. Use our lives for the spread of the gospel to the ends of the earth.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,100 – You will be with Me in Paradise (Luke 23:43)
description: In Christ, we have rock-solid, death-defying confidence that when we breathe our last in this life, we will be with Him in paradise.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,099 – The One Who Serves (Luke 22:24–27)
description: Lord, conform our understanding of greatness to the teaching of Christ and help us to be selfless servants.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,098 – My Words will not Pass Away (Luke 21:33)
description: Heaven and earth will pass away, but the Word of God will stand forever. Let's bank our lives on that which lasts forever.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,097 – Marvel Worthy Words (Luke 20:25)
description: Though Caesar is worthy of a coin in our pockets, only God is worthy of our hearts. We obey the government, but our ultimate allegiance is to God.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,096 – Weeping over the Lost (Luke 19:41)
description: Father, break our hearts for the lost who are right around us and far from us. Fill us with the compassion of Christ for those who do not know You.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,095 – The Parable of the Persistent Widow (Luke 18:1–8)
description: O God, teach us to always pray and not lose heart. Help us to pray with persistent trust in You.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,094 – Unworthy Servants (Luke 17:10)
description: Thanks be to God that we have the privilege of being servants of Jesus Christ. May we be faithful to carry out our duty.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,093 – Praying for the Protection of Marriages (Luke 16:18)
description: Lord, we ask for Your strength and protection that marriages might display the glory of your gospel.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,092 – The Parable of the Lost Sheep (Luke 15:3–7)
description: Praise God that he pursued us. He has thrown a joyful celebration in heaven over our salvation. May we be faithful to proclaim the good news that Jesus seeks and saves the lost.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,091 – Loving Jesus Supremely (Luke 14:26)
description: We pray today for our brothers and sisters throughout the world for whom the cost of following Jesus is severe. Lord, we ask for grace to love You more than we love our own lives.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,090 – Repent or Perish (Luke 13:1–5)
description: Lord, help us to not lose sight of the brevity of life and the urgency of eternity.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,089 – Savior, Like a Shepherd Lead Us (Luke 12:32)
description: Because of the Good Shepherd laying down His life for the sheep, we are God’s children and are citizens of His kingdom.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,088 – Glory, Gifts, Grace, and Guidance (Luke 11:2–4)
description: Jesus has given us a paradigm for prayer. Let's be faithful to cry out to our Father in heaven according to His Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,087 – The Harvest is Plentiful (Luke 10:2)
description: Jesus commands us to earnestly call out to the Lord of the harvest that laborers will be raised up to take the gospel to the ends of the earth.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,086 – Deny Yourself and Follow Christ (Luke 9:23)
description: Have you died to self and trusted in Christ alone for salvation? “If anyone would come after me, let him deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow me."
speaker: Platt

title: #1,085 – The Parable of the Sower (Luke 8:4–15)
description: "As for that in the good soil, they are those who, hearing the word, hold it fast in an honest and good heart, and bear fruit with patience."
speaker: Platt

title: #1,084 – Forgiven by God (Luke 7:41–43)
description: We pray that the lives we lead will show our realization of how we have been given grace upon grace. May Your forgiveness of our sins compel us to extravagant worship of You.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,083 – Removing Logs and Specks (Luke 6:41–42)
description: It is far easier to see sin in others than in ourselves. Lord, open our eyes to sin in our own hearts. We thank You for the salvation You have provided.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,082 – Proclaiming Salvation to Those far from God (Luke 5:29–32)
description: Father, use us to reach people that are far from You that they might know You and feast at Your table.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,081 – Empowered by His Spirit (Luke 4:1)
description: If you are in Christ, the Spirit of God dwells in you. Take comfort in this today.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,080 – The Urgency of the Gospel (Luke 3:17)
description: This verse shows us the severity of not trusting in Jesus for salvation. May we spend our lives proclaiming the gospel that many will be gathered into His barn to enjoy Him forever and ever.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,079 –  Waiting in Faith (Luke 2:25–32)
description: May we be found faithful as we wait upon the Lord. Even as we long for our waiting to be over, help us to be filled with joy in Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,078 – Use us to Spread Your Gospel (Luke 1:1–4)
description: Father, we ask for grace that we might contend for the faith. Use us today to share the good news of Jesus with someone who does not know You.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,077 – We Must Open Our Mouths (Mark 16:8)
description: We have been united with Christ in His death and resurrection. We cannot keep this news to ourselves. Lord help us to be faithful to proclaim Your gospel.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,076 – He Paid the Penalty for Our Sins (Mark 15:37)
description: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Jesus Christ our Lord.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,075 – Always be on Guard (Mark 14:30–31)
description: Father, we ask that You guard our hearts and minds in Christ Jesus. Help us to take heed lest we fall.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,074 – Stay Awake (Mark 13:35–37)
description: Are you ready for Christ to return? We ask for grace to stay awake, living with hopeful anticipation for the day when Jesus returns for His church.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,073 – Rendering to Caesar and to God (Mark 12:13–17)
description: Jesus explains how we are to view God and government. We obey the government as submissive citizens but ultimately we belong to and give our worship to God alone.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,072 – Spreading God's Glory Among the Nations (Mark 11:17)
description: Are we prioritizing ourselves more than the glory of God among the nations? Father, forgive us for our selfishness and help us to spend ourselves for the spread of Your gospel.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,071 – A Sobering Story (Mark 10:21–22)
description: May it not be said of us that we went away sorrowful because we chose to hold onto our ways rather than Yours, O Lord.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,070 – The Severity of Sin (Mark 9:47–48)
description: We ask for grace that God will keep us from becoming casual with sin.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,069 – Setting Our Minds on the Things of God (Mark 8:31–33)
description: Lord help us to not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of our minds. Teach us to set our minds on Your thoughts and not our own.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,068 – Hearts Close to Christ (Mark 7:6)
description: Father, help us to authentically worship You. May we honor You both with our lips and our lives.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,067 – Praying for Our Persecuted Brothers and Sisters (Mark 6:27–29)
description: Today we intercede on behalf of our brothers and sisters around the world who are being persecuted for following Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,066 – Jesus Cares for You (Mark 5:24–34)
description: In a sea of urgent need, Jesus stops for you. Be encouraged by this glorious truth today.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,065 – He is with Us (Mark 4:35–41)
description: The same Jesus who stilled the storm in Mark 4 is with us today. He promises to be with us until faith gives way to sight.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,064 – The Privilege of being with Jesus (Mark 3:14)
description: Lord, we praise You for the privilege of being with You. May we revel in deep communion with You and open our mouths preaching Christ and Him crucified.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,063 – Son, Your Sins are Forgiven (Mark 2:5)
description: We rejoice in Christ's authority to forgive sins and await the day when He will bring about ultimate healing. Help us to trust in You and proclaim the good news of Your gospel.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,062 – Follow Me (Mark 1:16–18)
description: Followers of Jesus do not always know where they are going, but they do always know who they are with.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,061 – The Urgent Need to Make Disciples (Matthew 28:19)
description: Father, help us to be faithful to make disciples. Use us to take the gospel where it has never gone so disciples will be made among all nations.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,060 – Open Eyes to Know Christ (Matthew 27:54)
description: Father, we ask that You open the eyes of those who do not know Christ and who He truly is. May they see Your glory in the face of Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,059 – The Joy of Sharing the Lord's Supper (Matthew 26:26–28)
description: In a time where many churches have been unable to gather to share the Lord's supper, we ask for help to remember regularly what Christ has accomplished through His cross.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,058 – Hearts for the Least of These (Matthew 25:40)
description: We delight in Christ's identification with us. Because of His love for us, we ask for grace to care for the least of these.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,057 – Praying for Unreached People Groups (Matthew 24:14)
description: Jesus has purchased people from every tribe and tongue. Let's pray for the gospel to advance among the unreached.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,056 – Servants of Others (Matthew 23:11)
description: Humility, The Life of Christ, The Person & Identity of Christ, Value & Authority of the Word, Love, Spiritual Growth, Evangelism & Making Disciples
speaker: Platt

title: #1,055 – Ultimate Allegiance Belongs to God (Matthew 22:21)
description: Christians are called to honor the government. As we live as submissive citizens in our countries, we know our ultimate allegiance is to You.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,054 – Calling out to God in Faith (Matthew 21:22)
description: Father, help us to be a people who are on our knees in faith. May we call out to You, trusting in Your providence.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,053 – He Came to Serve Us (Matthew 20:28)
description: Be in awe of the ways Christ serves us. He came not to be served but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,052 – Coming to the King like a Child (Matthew 19:13–15)
description: Jesus receives the humble and rejects the proud. We bow before the King of kings and Lord of lords.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,051 – Forgiving as we have been Forgiven  (Matthew 18:21–22)
description: Father, we give thanks for Your perfect patience towards us. May Your church forgive others as we have been forgiven by You.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,050 – Filled with Hope (Matthew 17:1–2)
description: A day is coming when we will see God as He is. Let's long for the day when Jesus will make all things new.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,049 – Take up Your Cross and Follow Jesus (Matthew 16:24–25)
description: Lord, we plead for help to turn from sin and deny ourselves. Might each day be marked by taking up our cross and following Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,048 – Praying in Faith (Matthew 15:28)
description: Father, help us to persevere in prayer. May we call out to you in faith day and night.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,047 – Turn Your Eyes Upon Jesus (Matthew 14:28–31)
description: Let's ask for grace that our eyes will be constantly fixed on Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,046 – The Infinite Value of Christ (Matthew 13:45–46)
description: We lay our plans and futures before You, O God. May we trust in You and spend our lives for the sake of Jesus receiving all glory and honor forever and ever.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,045 – Watching Our Words (Matthew 12:34–37)
description: What do your words say about your heart? Lord help the overflow of our hearts to glorify You.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,044 – Come, Lord Jesus (Matthew 11:4–5)
description: We look forward to Christ coming again. May we live to make the good news of Jesus known till He returns or calls us home.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,043 – Wise as Serpents and Innocent as Doves (Matthew 10:16)
description: Father, help us to be obedient to Your Word. Let's live not for the applause of men, but for the glory of God.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,042 – Send Out Laborers into the Harvest (Matthew 9:35–38)
description: May we constantly be on our knees calling out to the Lord of the harvest to raise up laborers for the advancement of the gospel to the ends of the earth.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,041 – He Makes Us Clean (Matthew 8:1–4)
description: Lord, we rejoice that You change the leper's spots and melt the heart of stone. All glory be to You for drawing near to us and cleansing us from sin. May we make Your cleansing power known.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,040 – Loving the Unreached as Ourselves (Matthew 7:12)
description: Father, help us to love the unreached as ourselves. Might we be compelled to spend our lives for the sake of the nations being glad.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,039 – Fasting that Honors God (Matthew 6:16–18)
description: Lord, Your love is better than life. Your Word is better than food and Your presence is our sustenance. May we fast in a way that brings glory to You.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,038 – Love Your Enemies (Matthew 5:43–48)
description: We realize that in our sin we were enemies with God. We rejoice that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us. Lord, help us to love our enemies.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,037 – Turn and Trust (Matthew 4:17)
description: Father, help us from the moment we wake up in the morning to turn from sin and self and trust in You. May we be marked by a posture of repentance.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,036 – Praying for Baptisms (Matthew 3:16–17)
description: Lord, we ask that You save people all over the world. Might churches be filled with many who are obedient to Christ in believer's baptism.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,035 – They Fell Down and Worshiped Him (Matthew 2:11)
description: Jesus is Lord and will receive the praise He is due. May our lives be spent for the sake of Jesus being praised.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,034 – The King has Come (Matthew 1:1)
description: Jesus is not distant from us, but has come to us. He lived the life we could not and died in our place on the cross.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,033 – What the Lord Requires  (Micah 6:8)
description: Lord, help us to do justice, love kindness, and walk humbly with You. May we long for the day when Your justice will fully and finally reign.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,032 – Praise the Lord (Psalm 150:6)
description: Let everything that has breath praise the Lord. The purpose of our lives is to praise Him. Lord, help our lives to be spent for Your glory.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,031 – The Lord Takes Pleasure in His People (Psalm 149:1–5)
description: If you have trusted in Christ, rest assured that the God of the universe takes pleasure in you.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,030 – He Commanded and They were Created (Psalm 148:5)
description: This verse puts on display the sovereignty of our God. Lord, keep us from getting to a point where we underestimate Your Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,029 – Heal Our Hearts and Bind Our Wounds (Psalm 147:3)
description: Help us to look to You as the only One who can heal our broken hearts and bind up our wounds.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,028 – Praise the Lord, O My Soul! (Psalm 146:1–2)
description: Father, may our lives be marked by giving You praise. Help us to live today longing for when we will be with You forever and ever.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,027 – Commending His Works to the Next Generation (Psalm 145:4)
description: O God, help us to be found faithful in commending Your works and mighty acts to the next generation.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,026 – Sing a New Song (Psalm 144:9)
description: Lord, may we ascribe to You the worship that You alone are due.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,025 – Pondering the Works of His Hands (Psalm 143:5)
description: Father, we look back and meditate on all You have done and rejoice that You are faithful. Use our lives for the display of Your glory.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,024 – When My Spirit Faints Within Me (Psalm 142:3)
description: God, You are our Refuge and Portion in the land of the living. We rejoice that in Your grace, You deal bountifully with us.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,023 – Surrendering Our Lives for God's Glory (Psalm 141:2)
description: Our lives belong to You, O God. We want our lives to be living sacrifices, holy and acceptable to You.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,022 – He Hears Our Pleas for Mercy (Psalm 140:6)
description: Father, we come to you on behalf of those who have not trusted in Christ for salvation. We plead for you to reconcile sinners for we know You alone can melt hearts of stone.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,021 – Held in God's Hands (Psalm 139:13–16)
description: "I praise you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Wonderful are your works; my soul knows it very well."
speaker: Platt

title: #1,020 – Strengthen Our Souls (Psalm 138:3)
description: Lord, we come to You during these days when we feel weary, tired, and frustrated. We call out to You for strength, knowing that You alone satisfy our souls.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,019 – Singing the Lord's Song in Uncertainty (Psalm 137:4)
description: How do we sing the Lord’s song in a foreign land? A prayer for all who are tired and weary amid these difficult days.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,018 – His Steadfast Love Endures Forever (Psalm 136:1–3)
description: O God, we pray Your enduring steadfast love over missionaries overseas who have family members dying of COVID-19 back home.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,017 – Your Name Endures Forever (Psalm 135:13)
description: In a world full of things that won’t last long (including our health), find rest in the reality that the name, renown, Word, and promises of the Lord endure forever.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,016 – Living to Glorify God (Psalm 134:1–2)
description: God, help us to live every single moment, in every single thing we do, cognizant of Your presence with us and longing for Your glory through us.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,015 – Unity in the Body of Christ (Psalm 133:1)
description: Amidst so many divisive issues swirling around us, may God give us supernatural unity in the church.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,014 – Longing to be Together (Psalm 132:6–7)
description: In the absence of being able to gather together, let's pray for one another. We pray specifically for children's ministries throughout the world who will be unable to meet for an extended period of time.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,013 – A Calmed and Quieted Soul (Psalm 131)
description: "But I have calmed and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with its mother; like a weaned child is my soul within me."
speaker: Platt

title: #1,012 – Hope During a Season of Waiting (Psalm 130:5–6)
description: Lord, we trust that as we are waiting, You are working. Our hope is in Your Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,011 – Praying for Persecuted Brothers and Sisters (Psalm 129:2)
description: Let's remember Christians throughout the world who are in chains and are persecuted because of their faith in Jesus.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,010 – Praying for Grandparents and Their Families (Psalm 128)
description: Lord, we ask for Your sustenance in these days for grandparents and for those caring for them. May they experience your peace that surpasses understanding.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,009 – Children are a Heritage from the Lord (Psalm 127)
description: Let's lift up children and spouses for whom home is not a safe place. Father, we ask that You help children to be valued as a heritage from the Lord.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,008 – The Lord has Done Great Things (Psalm 126:1–3)
description: O God, we pray today that You would restore jobs that we might make Your praise known in all sectors of society among all the nations.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,007 – The Lord Surrounds His People (Psalm 125:2)
description: "As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the Lord surrounds His people, from this time forth and forevermore."
speaker: Platt

title: #1,006 – Praying for Ahmaud Arbery's Mother (Psalm 124)
description: O God, we pray today for Your help for Wanda Cooper, and for Your help for us as we do justice and love mercy.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,005 – A Mother's Day Prayer (Psalm 123:1)
description: Today we pray for mothers. We also lift up those for whom this day is painful. Lord in each of these cases, we ask that you provide comfort through Your steadfast love.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,004 – Praying for Unity in the Church (Psalm 122:6–9)
description: As differing opinions abound during a time of difficult decisions, let's pray for churches to have the unity of God's Spirit in the bond of peace. May churches not be marked by division, but by the gospel of Jesus Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,003 – Your Help Comes from the Lord (Psalm 121:1–4)
description: We go to the Lord on behalf of those with special needs and their families. May they trust that their help comes from the Lord, who neither slumbers nor sleeps.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,002 – Calling out to God in Distress (Psalm 120:1)
description: Today we pray for couples dealing with the stress of altered marriage plans due to COVID–19. May they call out to the Lord in distress and find comfort in Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,001 – Fighting to Treasure God's Word (Psalm 119:162)
description: Let's pray for those struggling to feed on God's Word during this time. May God give them grace to rejoice at His Word like one who finds great spoil.
speaker: Platt

title: #1,000 – A Thousand Episodes of Pray the Word (Psalm 119:147)
description: Today we celebrate the privilege of praying God's Word together for a thousand episodes. "I rise before dawn and cry for help; I hope in your words."
speaker: Platt

title: #999 – Praying for Summer Camps (Psalm 119:105)
description: Today we pray for summer camps that might not be able to meet this summer. We ask that students, ministers, and leaders see that even in the middle of a pandemic, Your Word is a lamp to their feet and a light to their path.
speaker: Platt

title: #998 – The Comfort of God (Psalm 119:82)
description: "And we know that for those who love God all things work together for good, for those who are called according to his purpose."
speaker: Platt

title: #997 – God's Mercy Gives us Life (Psalm 119:77)
description: Father, we pray for the sick and hurting all over the world during this pandemic.
speaker: Platt

title: #996 – Praying for Restored Marriages (Psalm 119:50)
description: "This is my comfort in my affliction, that your promise gives me life."
speaker: Platt

title: #995 – Praying for College Students (Psalm 119:44–45)
description: Many college students experienced abrupt changes in an already uncertain time of life. Let's ask the Lord to bless them with every spiritual blessing in Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #994 – Praying for Those who are Mourning (Psalm 119:28)
description: In a time where families cannot mourn loss as they normally would, Lord we ask that you provide them comfort in You.
speaker: Platt

title: #993 – A Prayer for Healing (Psalm 119:8)
description: Today we pray for a brother and his family dealing with COVID–19. Lord, do that which only You can do. Help this family to know that because Christ was forsaken, they will never be.
speaker: Platt

title: #992 – Praying for Those Contemplating Suicide (Psalm 118:5)
description: Today we cry out to God on behalf of those who think they cannot keep going. Lord, we ask that You help them see that Christ came that they may have life, and have it abundantly.
speaker: Platt

title: #991 – Praise the Lord, all Nations! (Psalm 117)
description: Radical has launched a new initiative called Urgent—our work among the unreached of identifying and coming alongside indigenous believers who are making disciples and multiplying churches in ways that are biblically faithful and practically eff...
speaker: Platt

title: #990 – Praying for Prisoners and Correctional Officers (Psalm 116:1)
description: "I love the Lord, because he has heard my voice and my pleas for mercy."
speaker: Platt

title: #989 – Praying for Secret Church 20 (Psalm 115:1–8)
description: Father, we come to Your throne asking your blessing upon SC20. May tonight's gathering be used for the spread of your gospel to the ends of the earth.
speaker: Platt

title: #988 – Praying for Struggling Churches (Psalm 114:7–8)
description: Today we ask God to make a way for churches and pastors who are struggling to survive during COVID–19.
speaker: Platt

title: #987 – Praying for Those in the Adoption Process (Psalm 113:9)
description: Today we lift up families who are seeking to adopt and the children who are waiting to be adopted. Lord, we ask that You open the door for children to be brought home.
speaker: Platt

title: #986 – Praying for Those Serving Others (Psalm 112)
description: “Blessed is the man who fears the Lord, who greatly delights in his commandments! . . . He has distributed freely; he has given to the poor; his righteousness endures forever; his horn is exalted in honor.”
speaker: Platt

title: #985 – Praying for Farmers and Food Distributors (Psalm 111)
description: Today, we lift up those who labor and toil to ensure food makes it from the farm to our tables.
speaker: Platt

title: #984 – Praying for Those Impacted by Storms (Psalm 110:4)
description: Father, we come to you on behalf of our brothers and sisters who have been impacted by recent storms. In a world of constant change and uncertainty, may they find refuge in You, the unchanging One.
speaker: Platt

title: #983 – Praying for Those Suffering in Isolation (Psalm 109:30–31)
description: "With my mouth I will give great thanks to the Lord; I will praise him in the midst of the throng. For he stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save him from those who condemn his soul to death."
speaker: Platt

title: #982 – Praying for Those Intending to Go (Psalm 108:3)
description: Today we lift up those who were preparing to go and support the work of the church throughout the world. We ask that you help their zeal for You to increase during this difficult time.
speaker: Platt

title: #981 – Praying for Children in Abusive Homes (Psalm 107:39–42)
description: Lord, we ask that you bring an end to this evil. You are the One who raises the needy out of affliction. Cause all wickedness to shut its mouth.
speaker: Platt

title: #980 – Praying for People Groups in East Africa (Psalm 106:47)
description: "Save us, O Lord our God, and gather us from among the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name and glory in your praise."
speaker: Platt

title: #979 – Praying for Mental Health Workers (Psalm 105:4)
description: Today we pray for mental health workers who are standing in the gap for many people in a variety of ways during this pandemic.
speaker: Platt

title: #978 – Praying for Food Industry Workers (Psalm 104:27–28)
description: God is our Provider. Today we call out to Him on behalf of those who are tirelessly working to provide food for the world during this pandemic.
speaker: Platt

title: #977 – The Steadfast Love of God (Psalm 103:8–12)
description: Through Christ, our transgressions are removed as far as the east is from the west. Let's pray that God will draw many to Himself on this Easter Sunday.
speaker: Platt

title: #976 – Praying for Children Who Left the Faith (Psalm 102:1–2)
description: Father, we lift up those who left the faith. Please save them through the gospel of Your Son. Draw them to Yourself, we pray.
speaker: Platt

title: #975 – Walking with Integrity of Heart (Psalm 101:2–3)
description: Lord, we are prone to wander. We rejoice that Jesus has paid the penalty for our sins and we ask for grace to wage war on sin. Rather than setting our eyes on what is worthless, help us to turn our eyes upon Jesus.
speaker: Platt

title: #974 – Praying for Military Families (Psalm 100)
description: Let us pray for military families during these complex times. Lord, comfort them all in the glorious truth that those who are in Christ are the sheep of Your pasture.
speaker: Platt

title: #973 – Praying for Marriages (Psalm 99:6)
description: During this stressful time we pray for all husbands and wives. We ask the Lord for grace, that they will grow in affection for Him and for one another.
speaker: Platt

title: #972 – Praying for Missionaries (Psalm 98:2)
description: We ask that the Lord will open doors for missionaries to be able to get back to the front lines among the unreached. Father, cause Your salvation to be known among those who have not testified to the goodness of Your Son.
speaker: Platt

title: #971 – Praying for Joy in Isolation (Psalm 97:12)
description: Let's pray for single brothers and sisters during this time of quarantine. Amid many hours alone, may all these brothers and sisters know that the Lord is with them, for their good and for His glory.
speaker: Platt

title: #970 – Praying for Refugees (Psalm 96:3)
description: Today we pray specifically for refugees. Lord we ask that You comfort them and fill them with the hope of the resurrection. Cause Your gospel to go forth among refugees throughout the world.
speaker: Platt

title: #969 – Praying for Those with Special Needs (Psalm 95:6–7)
description: Today we ask the Lord to supply grace upon grace for those with special needs and their families. We also pray for those who serve the special needs community.
speaker: Platt

title: #968 – The Rock of Our Refuge (Psalm 94:22)
description: Lord, we ask that You provide opportunities for gospel conversations during this time. Father, cause many to come to faith in You as the Rock of their Refuge.
speaker: Platt

title: #967 – The Lord on High is Mighty (Psalm 93:3–4)
description: Today we pray for those who are preparing to have babies during this pandemic. We cry out to the God who is sovereign over all.
speaker: Platt

title: #966 – Praying for the Elderly During COVID–19 (Psalm 92:12–15)
description: Let's go to the Lord on behalf of senior saints in nursing homes and senior living facilities. Father, help these brothers and sisters to bear fuit even in difficult circumstances.
speaker: Platt

title: #965 – Our Refuge, Fortress, and Redeemer (Psalm 91)
description: Father, we rejoice that even in the middle of a pandemic, You are redeeming sinners. Help us to proclaim Your gospel that many more will trust in You.
speaker: Platt

title: #964 – Praying for God's Work Among the Unreached (Psalm 90:17)
description: Lord, establish Your church to thrive in an impoverished village even during a pandemic. We pray for those laboring and toiling for the advancement of the gospel in such a difficult context.
speaker: Platt

title: #963 – Jesus Delivers us from Death (Psalm 89:48)
description: Pray for someone in your life who does not know Jesus. Let's ask God to save them. Deliverance from ultimate death only comes through the finished work of Christ. May we share the good news of the gospel with them.
speaker: Platt

title: #962 – Calling Out to God Day and Night (Psalm 88:1)
description: Let's pray for those police officers, healthcare workers, government officials, and first responders who are working day and night. When we are weak, You are strong.
speaker: Platt

title: #961 – The Joy and Peace of God's Presence (Psalm 87:7)
description: Today, we pray for those who feel anxious and alone. Lord, help them to find comfort and rest in You. May Your church find ways to minister to those who are struggling during this time.
speaker: Platt

title: #960 – Calling Upon God for Grace (Psalm 86:5)
description: Lord, we pray for protection for healthcare workers during this pandemic. We ask in these tragic times, that You will cause multitudes to turn to You for salvation.
speaker: Platt

title: #959 – God's Character and Care for His Saints (Psalm 85:10)
description: "Steadfast love and faithfulness meet; righteousness and peace kiss each other."
speaker: Platt

title: #958 – Valleys Into Springs (Psalm 84:6)
description: God brings water to dry places. He makes valleys places of springs. And we pray that, in the midst of suffering and sickness, He would make these days fruitful.
speaker: Platt

title: #957 – Do Not Be Still, O God! (Psalm 83:1)
description: God, we need your peace in the middle of the unkown. Help us to turn to Your Word in dependence on You, for You are our only hope.
speaker: Platt

title: #956 – Praying for the Weak, Afflicted, and Destitute (Psalm 82:3–4)
description: As COVID-19 continues to wreak havoc throughout the world, let's call out to our gracious God who is indeed the Rescuer of the weak and needy.
speaker: Platt

title: #955 – Bought with a Price (1 Corinthians 6:19–20)
description: We belong to God. Jesus gave His life so we will be united with Christ forever. May we glorify Him with our bodies.
speaker: Platt

title: #954 – Flee Sexual Immorality (1 Corinthians 6:18)
description: We are desensitized to sexual sin. We must not flirt with sexual immorality but flee from it. Father, help us to say no sin and cling to the Savior.
speaker: Platt

title: #953 – Fighting Against Sexual Immorality (1 Corinthians 6:13)
description: We need God's grace to see that His commands are for our good. "The body is not meant for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body."
speaker: Platt

title: #952 – A Simple Principle (1 Corinthians 6:12)
description: Lord help us to live according to Your Word. May we be a people who value what is profitable over what is permissible.
speaker: Platt

title: #951 – Washed, Sanctified, and Justified (1 Corinthians 6:11)
description: We have been washed, sanctified, and justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.
speaker: Platt

title: #950 – Do not be Deceived (1 Corinthians 6:9-10)
description: We must be careful not to celebrate sin but to grieve over its reality. May we boldly proclaim Christ, realizing that eternity is at stake.
speaker: Platt

title: #949 – Pursuing Reconciliation in the Church (1 Corinthians 6:1)
description: God give us wisdom to find reconciliation in the church. May we be a picture of unity to the watching world around us.
speaker: Platt

title: #948 – The Church Built According to God's Word (1 Corinthians 5:13)
description: Church discipline is not natural to us. Let us ask God for grace that we will play our part in His church being built according to His Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #947 – Confronting Sin in the Church (1 Corinthians 5:9–11)
description: We must be careful not to be selective in our gracious confrontation of sin in the church. Lord, help us to love our brothers and sisters well according to Your Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #946 – Christ Our Passover Lamb (1 Corinthians 5:7)
description: Church discipline is important because it shows the sacrifice of Christ to be supremely precious in the church. May we live in the freedom that Christ has purchased for us.
speaker: Platt

title: #945 – Taking Sin Seriously (1 Corinthians 5:6)
description: Father, we need help to flee from sin. Help us to see sin for what it really is, wage war on it, and run into Your kind arms.
speaker: Platt

title: #944 – Praying for Restoration in the Church (1 Corinthians 5:4–5)
description: Lord, we ask that You would use church discipline to bring people to repentance.
speaker: Platt

title: #943 – God's Word on Church Discipline (1 Corinthians 5:2)
description: Tolerating unrepentant sin in the church is arrogance. Let's ask God to help us to do the hard and necessary work when it comes to church discipline.
speaker: Platt

title: #942 – Dealing with Sin in the Church (1 Corinthians 5:1)
description: God holds the church responsible for the holiness of its members. We need God's grace to reform our understanding of the church and our role in it. May he keep us from only looking out for our own interests.
speaker: Platt

title: #941 – A Realization of the Kingdom (1 Corinthians 4:20)
description: "For the kingdom of God does not exist in talk but in power."
speaker: Platt

title: #940 – A Life Worthy of Imitation (1 Corinthians 4:16)
description: Others should be able to imitate our lives and by imitating us, experience lives that cling to Christ. Lord, help us to live in a way that can be imitated by others for the glory of Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #939 – Praying for Discipleship (1 Corinthians 4:15)
description: Don't you want to lead others to Christ and help others to follow Him? Let's ask God to help us be spiritual parents in the lives of others.
speaker: Platt

title: #938 – A Recipe for Humility (1 Corinthians 4:7)
description: Lord, everything that is good is from You. Nothing good in us is from us. We ask that you rid us of pride, that we may humbly cling to You.
speaker: Platt

title: #937 – The Purposes of Our Hearts Matter (1 Corinthians 4:5)
description: Let's ask God to purify the purposes of our hearts. Lord, make us pure and holy in our hearts and desires that You might be glorified.
speaker: Platt

title: #936 – Jesus is Our Judge (1 Corinthians 4:3)
description: We don't live for the approval of others or for the approval of self. We live for the approval of our Judge—His name is Jesus.
speaker: Platt

title: #935 – Success as Servants and Stewards (1 Corinthians 4:1–2)
description: "This is how one should regard us, as servants of Christ and stewards of the mysteries of God. Moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful."
speaker: Platt

title: #934 – Do Not Boast in Men (1 Corinthians 3:21–23)
description: May God give us grace to boast in Him. We need not acceptance, approval, or applause from the world because we are accepted by God in Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #933 – The Church as God's Temple (1 Corinthians 3:16)
description: Lord we pray that You will give us a high view of Your church as Your temple.
speaker: Platt

title: #932 – Building Up The Church (1 Corinthians 3:12–13)
description: Are we exalting God by doing church according to His Word and not our ways? We need Your grace to be faithful servants.
speaker: Platt

title: #931 – The Church's One Foundation (1 Corinthians 3:10–11)
description: We do not have the option of building Christ's church however we want. Lord help us to play our part in the building of Your church according to Your Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #930 – Praying for Churches and Leaders (1 Corinthians 3:9)
description: May local churches be fields that are flourishing for Your glory. buildings constructed in every way according to Your Word for the display of Your glory. Make us to be what You desire for the spread of Your glory in the world.
speaker: Platt

title: #929 – God Gives the Growth (1 Corinthians 3:6–7)
description: Lord, we ask that You give us humility to labor, plant, and water for the sake of Your glory.
speaker: Platt

title: #928 – Continually Growing (1 Corinthians 3:1–3)
description: We want to grow more and more in our knowledge of and dependence on God's Word. Lord, please keep us from apathy and coasting through the Christian life. Give us grace to trust You more.
speaker: Platt

title: #927 – The Mind of Christ (1 Corinthians 2:16)
description: The revolutionary truth of Christianity is that Jesus died for us that He might live in us. Our lives are now in union with Him, and we have been given the mind of Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #926 – Desperate Dependence on God's Spirit (1 Corinthians 2:13)
description: We must be desperate for the Spirit of God, not dependent upon ourselves, but on Him who is able.
speaker: Platt

title: #925 – We Have God's Spirit (1 Corinthians 2:10–12)
description: "Now we have received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, that we might understand the things freely given us by God."
speaker: Platt

title: #924 – The Greatness of God's Wisdom (1 Corinthians 2:9)
description: Lord help us to live according to Your ways. We want the high life, not according to the world, but according to Your Word
speaker: Platt

title: #923 – Live According to God's Wisdom (1 Corinthians 2:7–8)
description: We are faced with a question when we wake up each morning: will we live according to the wisdom of the world or according to the wisdom of God?
speaker: Platt

title: #922 – Proclaiming Christ (1 Corinthians 2:4-5)
description: "My speech and my message were not in plausible words of wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power, so that your faith might not rest in the wisdom of men but in the power of God."
speaker: Platt

title: #921 – Weak and Fearful (1 Corinthians 2:3)
description: We confess that we are weak and fearful. We need God's supernatural grace to help us to be bold in proclaiming the good news of the gospel.
speaker: Platt

title: #920 – Boast in the Lord (1 Corinthians 1:30–31)
description: The only way we can stand before God is by boasting in what Christ has done in His death and resurrection.
speaker: Platt

title: #919 – The Greatest News in the World (1 Corinthians 1:22–24)
description: "For Jews demand signs and Greeks seek wisdom, but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and folly to Gentiles, but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God."
speaker: Platt

title: #918 – The Power of the Gospel (1 Corinthians 1:17)
description: It is freeing to know that we can share the good news of the gospel in confidence, knowing that He uses His gospel to bring people to Himself from every tribe and tongue.
speaker: Platt

title: #917 – Praying for Unity in Christ's Church (1 Corinthians 1:10)
description: May we be kept from trying to be united by traditions, teachers, or anything else when the only one who can truly unite us is Jesus Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #916 – He is Faithful (1 Corinthians 1:9)
description: Lord, help us to live our lives abiding in You, the Faithful One.
speaker: Platt

title: #915 – Sustained Until the End (1 Corinthians 1:8)
description: Christians should take great comfort in a Savior that promises to cause His saints to persevere until the end.
speaker: Platt

title: #914 – Called as Saints in Christ Jesus (1 Corinthians 1:1–2)
description: Lord we give You thanks for calling us to Yourself. Please continue to make us more like Christ. Sanctify us by Your grace today.
speaker: Platt

title: #913 – Wonderfully Made (Psalm 139:14)
description: You have been knitted together by the God of the universe. Take comfort in this and humbly worship Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #912 – The Exaltation of God's Word (Psalm 138:2)
description: Do you revere God's Word in a way that leads to worship and adoration of Him? May we live in a way that exalts His Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #911 – Living with an Eternal Perspective (Psalm 137:6)
description: Lord, help us to live today and every day realizing that our citizenship is in heaven.
speaker: Platt

title: #910 – His Love Endures Forever (Psalm 136:1–2)
description: In a world of unknowns, we have an absolute certainty. The Love of God for us will never ever end.
speaker: Platt

title: #909 – Bless the Lord (Psalm 135:21)
description: In response to God's blessing of us, we ascribe honor, glory, and praise to Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #908 – The Lord's Blessing (Psalm 134:3)
