description: "May the Lord bless you from Zion, He who made heaven and earth!"
speaker: Platt

title: #907 – Unity in Christ (Psalm 133:1)
description: May local churches come together in light of the good news of Jesus Christ. Lord help churches to be filled with unity around the gospel.
speaker: Platt

title: #906 – Clothed in His Righteousness (Psalm 132:9)
description: By God's grace through the finished work of Jesus, we are clothed in the righteousness of Christ.v
speaker: Platt

title: #905 – Hope in God (Psalm 131)
description: Lord help our souls to be calmed and quieted as we hope in You, knowing that in You we find rest for our souls.
speaker: Platt

title: #904 – Waiting in Dependence on Your Word (Psalm 130:5–6)
description: Lord as we wait for the day when you call us home, help us to trust in You. May we rest confidently knowing a day is coming when you wipe away every tear from our eyes.
speaker: Platt

title: #903 – The Righteousness of God (Psalm 129:4)
description: Though we deserve eternal destruction, through Jesus Christ dying on the cross we are covered by His righteousness for all eternity.
speaker: Platt

title: #902 – An Eternal Family (Psalm 128:6)
description: When we fear God, we find ourselves as a part of a family that transcends this world.
speaker: Platt

title: #901 – Praying for Children (Psalm 127:4)
description: "Like arrows in the hand of a warrior are the children of one's youth."
speaker: Platt

title: #900 – Revive Us Again (Psalm 126:4)
description: Lord, we pray for revival. Restore us to a closeness with You that only comes through repentance for our good and Your glory.
speaker: Platt

title: #899 – The Lord Surrounds His People (Psalm 125:2)
description: "As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the Lord surrounds His people, from this time forth and forevermore."
speaker: Platt

title: #898 – The Lord is on Our Side (Psalm 124:2–3)
description: If God is for us, who can stand against us? In our gracious God we have a perfect defender, provider, and protector.
speaker: Platt

title: #897 – Turn Your Eyes Upon Jesus  (Psalm 123:1)
description: Lord, amid whatever is going on in our lives may we look to You, knowing our help comes from the Lord.
speaker: Platt

title: #896 – Safe and Secure in Jesus (Psalm 122:6–7)
description: Because of Christ, even death cannot breach the security we have in Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #895 – He Does not Sleep nor Slumber (Psalm 121:3–4)
description: We require sleep every single day of our lives, but the One who sustains us does not. We will go to sleep tonight, but God does not sleep or slumber.
speaker: Platt

title: #894 – Our Help in Distress (Psalm 120:1)
description: "In my distress I called to the Lord, and he answered me."
speaker: Platt

title: #893 – Walking in His Word (Psalm 119:1)
description: May we know God's Word and allow it to direct every area of our lives.
speaker: Platt

title: #892 – Let Us Rejoice and Be Glad (Psalm 118:24)
description: It infuses meaning into today to know that God has made the day and has a purpose for it. This is the day that the Lord has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
speaker: Platt

title: #891 – A Constant Call (Psalm 117:1)
description: Churches exist to see God praised and extoled among all nations. Global mission is not a program in the church, but the purpose for which we have breath.
speaker: Platt

title: #890 – Though We Die, Yet We Shall Live (Psalm 116:15)
description: Through the gospel, God has taken death and turned it into the best thing that can happen to us. To live is Christ and to die is gain.
speaker: Platt

title: #889 – To God be the Glory (Psalm 115:1)
description: Lord, may You become greater and may we become less. For the sake of Your steadfast love and faithfulness, may You receive all glory.
speaker: Platt

title: #888 – Tremble at His Presence (Psalm 114:7–8)
description: The God who provided in the Old Testament is the God who is committed to providing for you today. Does this compel you to tremble in awe before Him?
speaker: Platt

title: #887 – Praying for Those Who Long for Children (Psalm 113:9)
description: "He gives the barren woman a home, making her the joyous mother of children. Praise the Lord!"
speaker: Platt

title: #886 – How Firm a Foundation (Psalm 112:7)
description: Don't you want a life that rests on a sure foundation? This is what is afforded to us through the good news of Christ. Lord help us to trust in You.
speaker: Platt

title: #885 – Delighting in the Works of the Lord (Psalm 111:2)
description: We praise God for His works in the past, the way He is working right now, and for what He will do in the future. Great are the works of the Lord. May we delight in Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #884 – The Lord Will Not Change His Mind (Psalm 110:4)
description: You can rest in the Word of God and all His promises. You can put all of your trust in Him and know you will not be put to shame.
speaker: Platt

title: #883 – Deal on My Behalf for Your Name's Sake (Psalm 109:21)
description: Lord help our prayers to consist of petitions asking for Your grace, receiving Your grace, and all of this taking place for Your glory.
speaker: Platt

title: #882 – Let Your Glory Fill the Earth (Psalm 108:5)
description: Does the glory of God drive your prayer life? May our lives be marked by longing for God to be exalted and His glory to fill the earth.
speaker: Platt

title: #881 – His Steadfast Love Endures Forever (Psalm 107:1)
description: In a world of fleeting love and heartbreak, we can rest assured that God's love for us is steadfast and endures forever.
speaker: Platt

title: #880 – Responding to God's Word in Worship (Psalm 106:12)
description: Corporate worship is a rhythm of revelation and response. We gather, hear God's Word, and respond in adoration of Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #879 – Giving Thanks and Making Christ Known (Psalm 105:1)
description: Lord help us to see that making Your deeds known among the peoples is as fundamental as giving You thanks and calling upon Your name.
speaker: Platt

title: #878 – All Creatures of Our God and King (Psalm 104:24)
description: The vastness of God's creative power should compel us to worship Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #877 – Dealt with According to Christ's Righteousness (Psalm 103:10–12)
description: For all who are in Christ, God deals with us not according to our sins, but according to the righteousness of Jesus. He has paid the penalty for sinners to bring them back to God.
speaker: Platt

title: #876 – A Godly Audacity (Psalm 102:2)
description: God has promised that He is with His people, even in the middle of our distress. May we call out to God boldly, knowing that He is for our good and His glory.
speaker: Platt

title: #875 – Walking with Integrity of Heart (Psalm 101:2)
description: Let's pray that, by God's grace in the power of His Spirit, our lives, both public and private, will be marked by walking with integrity of heart.
speaker: Platt

title: #874 – Flee Temptation and Pursue Christ (1 Timothy 6:11)
description: Lord help us to say no to sin and to pursue Christ. May we be marked by a pursuit of righteousness, godliness, faith, love, steadfastness, and gentleness.
speaker: Platt

title: #873 – Praying for the Local Church (1 Timothy 5:1–2)
description: The church is united by Christ. We are a family. Prioritize praying for the local church which you are a part of.
speaker: Platt

title: #872 – Training in Godliness (1 Timothy 4:7–8)
description: Bodily training is of some value, but training in godliness is infinitely valuable for today and for all eternity. O Lord may we continually long to grow in our dependence on You.
speaker: Platt

title: #871 – Praying for Pastors (1 Timothy 3:1)
description: Paul tells Timothy that there are qualifications to be a pastor. Let's pray that these characteristics will be true of our pastors in Christ's church.
speaker: Platt

title: #870 – Praying for Leaders (1 Timothy 2:1–2)
description: We are commanded in God's Word to pray for those in authority. Lord, help us to obey in this way.
speaker: Platt

title: #869 – Perfect Patience (1 Timothy 1:16)
description: Let's praise God for His patience towards us. Each of our lives display a picture of God's perfect patience.
speaker: Platt

title: #868 – God with Us, Forever (Revelation 22:1–5)
description: On this Christmas Day, let's long for the day when we will rule and reign with our God forever. Come, Lord Jesus, come quickly.
speaker: Platt

title: #867 – Love on Display (1 John 4:14)
description: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent His Son to be the Savior of the world. May God use our lives to make known the greatest news there is.
speaker: Platt

title: #866 – He Has Spoken to Us by His Son (Hebrews 1:1–4)
description: We celebrate all that Christ accomplished in His first coming and look forward to the day when the One who is seated at the right hand of the Father comes again to bring His church into the presence of God for all eternity.
speaker: Platt

title: #865 – From Bitterness to Blessing (Ruth 4:14)
description: You may feel at times like Naomi did in Ruth 1–bitter, barren, hurt, despairing, and hopeless. But if you are trusting in Jesus, you can persevere with hope because a day is coming when death and sorrow will be no more.
speaker: Platt

title: #864 – His Mercies Never End  (Lamentations 3:19–24)
description: God's mercies for you are new every morning. His steadfast love for you never ceases. He is faithful, and even in the midst of tragedy we can hope in Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #863 – The Spirit Shall Rest on Him (Isaiah 11:1–2)
description: Through the work of Christ, the Spirit that rested on Him is given to us by His grace through faith in Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #862 – The Prince of Peace (Isaiah 9:6)
description: Jesus has made peace with God on our behalf. In Christ, we will experience peace, joy, justice and righteousness forever.
speaker: Platt

title: #861 – Everlasting Father (Isaiah 9:6)
description: The Son who came to save us cares for us with the perfect eternal affection of an Everlasting Father.
speaker: Platt

title: #860 – Mighty God (Isaiah 9:6)
description: The child who we celebrate at Christmas is the Mighty God who has come to us. Jesus identified with us in every way yet was without sin and has saved us through His finished work in the cross and resurrection.
speaker: Platt

title: #859 – Wonderful Counselor (Isaiah 9:6)
description: In Jesus we have a perfect and reliable counselor. Jesus leads us according to that which is good and right.
speaker: Platt

title: #858 – Redeemed by God (Ruth 3:9)
description: God sent Jesus to redeem us by dying on the cross in our place. Christian, take comfort that you have been bought by God. We are made righteous in Christ and will experience eternal joy with Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #857 – A Desire Fulfilled (Proverbs 13:12)
description: This proverb is a picture of the advent season. After much waiting and anticipation, we rejoice that the hope of God has come!
speaker: Platt

title: #856 – He Came to Set Us Free (Psalm 102:18–22)
description: We were in bondage to sin, but Christ graciously came to set us free from sin's penalty. He promises that we are being freed from sin's power and will one day be free even from sin's presence.
speaker: Platt

title: #855 – Longing for His Justice (Psalm 98:7–9)
description: We have been saved through the satisfaction of God's justice at the cross. Through the work of Christ, the Just has justified us. Now, we long for and rejoice in God's justice, that He will come again and make all things new.
speaker: Platt

title: #854 – The God Who Remembers (Psalm 74:1–3)
description: God's people are right to call upon Him to keep His promises. How much more should we pray this way today since we have seen God's promised redemption fulfilled through the death and resurrection of Christ?
speaker: Platt

title: #853 – A Sufficient Sacrifice (Psalm 40:6–10)
description: Only Jesus is qualified to bear the weight of our sin as a substitute. Through His perfect sacrifice on the cross we are welcomed into the presence of God.
speaker: Platt

title: #852 – Kiss the Son (Psalm 2:10–12)
description: Have you bowed the knee to King Jesus? Have you taken refuge under His rule? Believe in Him and find refuge.
speaker: Platt

title: #851 – Find Refuge Under His Wings (Ruth 2:12)
description: Those who trust in Christ for salvation find refuge under God's wings. There is no need for anxiety or fear under the wings of the God of the universe.
speaker: Platt

title: #850 – Breaking the Cycle of Sin (Judges 2:11–15)
description: All we like sheep have gone astray. We are all in bondage to sin, but God sent Jesus to break the cycle of sin. Through His perfect life, death, and resurrection we are forgiven of our sins and regarded as righteous in His sight.
speaker: Platt

title: #849 – I Will Put My Words in His Mouth  (Deuteronomy 18:18)
description: This passage tells us how Jesus would come as the Perfect Prophet and how God would speak to us by His Son. May the Lord help us to take Him at His Word and cling to Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #847 – The Privilege of His Presence (Exodus 40:34–38)
description: We have the Holy Spirit of God, the glory of God, dwelling in us right now. He's leading us, guiding us, and transforming us into the image of Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #846 – Looking and Living for Our Future Reward (Genesis 47:29–31)
description: May we lift our eyes from this world and all that it offers and look to the promises of God, for He has called us to another world, a heavenly country, a new heaven and a new earth.
speaker: Platt

title: #845 – Walking by Faith (Genesis 12:1–3)
description: As Abraham walked by faith and not by sight, may the same be said of us. May we cling to the cross of Christ for all of our days.
speaker: Platt

title: #844 – Hope for the Hopeless (Ruth 1:22)
description: Our God has a track record of taking the darkest days and shining light in the brightest ways. In Him we have a hope that will not put us to shame.
speaker: Platt

title: #843 – The Urgency of Eternity (Revelation 20:15)
description: Every person will one day enter into everlasting life or eternal torment. May we urgently proclaim the gospel while we still can.
speaker: Platt

title: #842 – Glorified with Christ Forever (Revelation 19:7)
description: A day is coming where our union with Christ will be made perfect. There will be no more sorrow, suffering, or sickness. Lord, help us to long for this day.
speaker: Platt

title: #841 – Every Tribe, Language, People and Nation (Revelation 5:9)
description: God's goal is for every tribe, language, people, and nation to praise Him. Is this our goal? Lord, may it be so.
speaker: Platt

title: #840 – Prayerlessness is Pride (Revelation 3:17)
description: When we do not pray, we show that we believe we are self sufficient. God help us to see that apart from You we can do nothing.
speaker: Platt

title: #839 – Patient Endurance (Revelation 1:9)
description: The Christian life is one of patient endurance. Moment by moment and day by day, may we trust in Jesus even amid trials and tribulations.
speaker: Platt

title: #838 – Because He First Loved Us (1 John 4:19)
description: Out of the overflow of love we have received from God in Christ, may we love the Lord, His church, and all of those around us and throughout the world.
speaker: Platt

title: #837 – Heed Instruction from God's Word (Proverbs 10:17)
description: If you do not heed instruction from God's Word, not only will you be led astray, but you will lead others on a path to death.
speaker: Platt

title: #836 – Faithful to Forgive (1 John 1:9)
description: May the confession of sin be an ongoing part of our relationship with God and in this we will experience forgiveness and cleansing according to His faithfulness.
speaker: Platt

title: #835 – He is Patient (2 Peter 3:9)
description: Lord we pray that you will bring many to repentance, that they may know You and realize Your patience and kindness to sinners.
speaker: Platt

title: #834 – He Cares for You (1 Peter 5:7)
description: How are we to deal with anxiety? We are to look to God, cast our anxieties on Him, and know that He cares for us.
speaker: Platt

title: #833 – Unhindered Prayers (1 Peter 3:7)
description: Our relationships with others affect our relationship with God. Lord, help husbands to love their wives as Christ loved the church. Help all of us to care for others around us the way you have called us to do so.
speaker: Platt

title: #832 – Called to Proclaim His Excellencies (1 Peter 2:9)
description: By God's grace, we belong to Him. We have been brought out of darkness into His marvelous light. May we be faithful to proclaim His excellencies.
speaker: Platt

title: #831 – Made Complete and Equipped by His Word (2 Timothy 3:16)
description: The One who knows what is best for us has given us His Word. It is profitable for teaching, reproof, correction, and training in righteousness that we may be complete, equipped for every good work.
speaker: Platt

title: #830 – Fighting Against Folly (Proverbs 9:13)
description: Folly is loud and seductive, yet it knows nothing. Lord help us to see through foolishness. May we turn to Your Word and live out of the overflow of Your wisdom.
speaker: Platt

title: #829 – No Reason to Fear (2 Timothy 1:7)
description: What causes you to be anxious? What causes you to worry or be filled with fear? See that God has not given you a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control. Lord deliver us from anxiety and worry.
speaker: Platt

title: #828 – Prayer and Spiritual Warfare (1 Timothy 4:1)
description: There is a spiritual battle going on around us at this very moment. God has given us prayer as weapon to fight the good fight of faith.
speaker: Platt

title: #827 – Praying for all People (1 Timothy 2:1–4)
description: This passage exhorts us to pray for everyone. May we as followers of Christ be faithful to pray for leaders and those in high places and also pray for those in low places all over the world.
speaker: Platt

title: #826 – Discipline that is Fruitful (Hebrews 12:11)
description: Lord we ask for Your loving, compassionate, and wise discipline in our lives. Train us with your discipline to run from sin and to trust in You.
speaker: Platt

title: #825 – Living by Faith (Hebrews 11:1)
description: God has not called us to a blind leap into the dark, but to bank our lives on the One who is dependable and faithful.
speaker: Platt

title: #824 – A Sacrifice for all Time (Hebrews 10:12)
description: Jesus Christ came and made purification for sins, the sacrifice to end all sacrifices to bring sinners back to God. He rose from the grave in victory and is seated at the right hand of God.
speaker: Platt

title: #823 – A Prayer for Wisdom (Proverbs 8:10–11)
description: Lord, we ask for a right view of wisdom compared to everything this world offers. May we long for wisdom according to Your Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #822 – Remembering Sin No More (Hebrews 8:12)
description: Let us not beat ourselves up for that which God remembers no more. When Satan tempts you to despair and tells you of the guilt within, look up and see Him there who made an end of all your sin.
speaker: Platt

title: #821 – A Better Hope (Hebrews 7:18–19)
description: Jesus, the perfect High Priest has come and laid down His life as a substitute. He has paid for our sins and conquered the grave. All who trust in Jesus can draw near to God.
speaker: Platt

title: Growing Up in Christ (Hebrews 6:1)
description: In this episode of Pray the Word on Hebrews 6:1, David Platt reminds us that we are to grow in maturity in the local church.
speaker: Platt

title: #820 – Growing up in Christ (Hebrews 6:1)
description: Are you stuck in a rut in the Christian life? God has called us to continue growing in Christ. There is no room for complacency in the life of the Christian
speaker: Platt

title: #819 – Sharper than any Two-Edged Sword (Hebrews 4:12)
description: Even right now, God's Word is living and active. It is sharper than any two edged sword. His Word penetrates the depths of our being and transforms us from the inside out.
speaker: Platt

title: #818 – Victory Over Temptation (Hebrews 2:18)
description: The One who was tempted in every way yet did not give into sin, lives in you. There is no temptation that you cannot overcome in Christ. Through Jesus, we are no longer under sin's bondage.
speaker: Platt

title: #817 – Standing Firm in Jesus (Philippians 4:1)
description: Do we long for our brothers and sisters in the church to stand firm in Jesus? May it bring us joy to see our fellow followers of Jesus standing firm in Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #816 – A Warning Against Adultery (Proverbs 7:27)
description: Lord, help us all to flee sexual immorality. Give us grace to flee all sexual thoughts, desires, and activities outside of marriage between a man and woman.
speaker: Platt

title: #815 – Being Prompted to Pray for Others (Philippians 1:3–4)
description: Let Philippians 1:3–4 prompt you to pray continually for those who are around you.
speaker: Platt

title: #814 – Imitators of God (Ephesians 5:1)
description: We are called to imitate God as His children. O Lord, may we be a walking reflection of You out of the overflow of being Your beloved children.
speaker: Platt

title: #813 – Speaking the Truth in Love (Ephesians 4:15–16)
description: May we not be those who speak about others, but may we speak the truth in love. This is God's design for the church in Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #812 – He Himself is Our Peace (Ephesians 2:14)
description: Jesus has broken down the dividing wall of hostility. Let's pray for unity in the church and for the spread of the gospel where Christ has not yet been praised.
speaker: Platt

title: #811 – The Character of Christ in Us (Colossians 3:12–15)
description: Put on then, as God's chosen ones, holy and beloved, compassionate hearts, kindness, humility, meekness, and patience, bearing with one another and, if one has a complaint against another, forgiving each other; as the Lord has forgiven you, so ...
speaker: Platt

title: #810 – Courage-Giving Fellowship (Acts 28:15)
description: You are not alone. Let's thank God for saving us into a family. Take courage from fellowshiping with others in Christ and look for opportunities to give courage to others.
speaker: Platt

title: #809 – Created to Work (Proverbs 6:6–11)
description: God has made us to labor for His glory. Lord, deliver us from both idleness and the idolatry of work. In everything we do, may we glorify You.
speaker: Platt

title: #808 –The Preeminence of Christ (Colossians 1:16)
description: For by Him all things were created, in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities–all things were created through Him and for Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #807 – A Calling for all of Us (Acts 26:18)
description: Lord help us to play our role in You opening the eyes of the lost and bringing them out of darkness into the light.
speaker: Platt

title: #806 – A Clear Conscience (Acts 24:16)
description: Do you long to have a clear conscience before God and others? Pray for God's help that you may have the integrity Paul displays in Acts 24.
speaker: Platt

title: #805 – Praying for the Persecuted (Acts 22:22)
description: We have brothers and sisters all throughout the world who are suffering for following Jesus. As we pray for their boldness and continual dependence on Christ, let us also pray that we will be bold in sharing the good news of Jesus.
speaker: Platt

title: #804 – A Responsibility to Proclaim God's Word (Acts 20:26–27)
description: May God give us grace to not stay silent. Let's be faithful to humbly proclaim the whole counsel of God's Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #803 – Taking the Gospel to the Unreached (Romans 15:23–24)
description: Just as Paul wrote to the church at Rome, even now God is calling people to take the gospel where Christ has not yet been praised. Let's pray for this: that God will send laborers into the harvest.
speaker: Platt

title: #802 – Praying for Contentment (Proverbs 5:15)
description: Lord keep us from looking to other cisterns to satisfy us. We pray that you will help us to be faithful, even in the face of temptation.
speaker: Platt

title: #801 – We Belong to the Lord (Romans 14:8)
description: Whether we live or whether we die, our focus is to be on how we can glorify Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #800 – Lay Your Life Down Before Him (Romans 12:1–2)
description: Lord help us not to be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of our minds. In light of your mercy, may we worship you.
speaker: Platt

title: #799 – Selfless Love for the Lost (Romans 9:1–3)
description: Paul longs, with extraordinary love, for others to know Christ. In light of the cross of Jesus, we must be filled with compassionate resolve for others to hear the gospel and trust in Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #798 – Led by God's Spirit as Sons (Romans 8:14)
description: For we have not received a spirit of slavery to fall back into fear, but have received the Spirit of adoption as sons, by whom we cry, "Abba! Father!"
speaker: Platt

title: #797 – Hope Does Not Put Us to Shame (Romans 5:3–5)
description: Even in the midst of pain and suffering, we see God refining us. We are called to endure knowing that our hope in Christ will not put us to shame.
speaker: Platt

title: #796 – Standing on the Promises of God (Romans 4:20–21)
description: Abraham took God at His Word. May we do the same and trust that all the promises of God have reached their yes and amen in Christ. Lord, help our unbelief.
speaker: Platt

title: #795 – A Disciplined Pursuit of God (Proverbs 5:23)
description: Growth in spiritual disciplines will not happen accidentally. Let's ask God to help us not to be led into folly, but to carry out our lives in disciplined pursuit of Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #794 – Under Obligation to Share the Gospel (Romans 1:14–15)
description: We have been given a glorious privilege to proclaim the good news of Jesus to a lost and dying world around us. God, please use us today to serve our joyful obligation to proclaim Christ and Him crucified.
speaker: Platt

title: #793 – Spent for the Souls of Others (2 Corinthians 12:15)
description: Are you spending your life for the good of the souls of others? God, give us a desire to spend our lives for the good of others.
speaker: Platt

title: #792 – Strength in Weakness (2 Corinthians 10:10)
description: Do you ever feel like you cannot do what God has called you to do? You are weak, but Christ is strong. You can trust in Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #791 – Godly Grief (2 Corinthians 7:10)
description: When it comes to sin in our lives, let's ask that God will give us godly grief that produces repentance.
speaker: Platt

title: #790 – Ambassadors for Christ (2 Corinthians 5:20)
description: Christian, you represent Jesus and have the privilege of calling others to trust in Jesus and become citizens of a heavenly kingdom.
speaker: Platt

title: #789 – Living in a Battlefield (2 Corinthians 4:4–6)
description: So often in the Christian life, we can live day by day being silent while the battle rages around us. Let's engage in the battle by preaching Christ. May we speak the gospel today.
speaker: Platt

title: #788 – Ponder the Path of Your Feet (Proverbs 4:25–27)
description: May God help us to refrain from flirting with sin. We are prone to wander at every turn, but let's wage war on sin and keep our feet moving forward on the path to which God has called us.
speaker: Platt

title: #787 – Comfort in Affliction (2 Corinthians 1:3–4)
description: We have a God who gives comfort in affliction. He is the Father of mercies and God of all comfort.
speaker: Platt

title: #786 – Depending on God's Grace Today (1 Corinthians 15:10)
description: Lord help us to labor and toil by Your grace for Your glory. May we be dependent upon Your grace today.
speaker: Platt

title: #785 – A Picture of Love (1 Corinthians 13:4–7)
description: Let's pray that the depiction of love in 1 Corinthians 13 will mark each of our lives.
speaker: Platt

title: #784 – Member of the Body of Christ (1 Corinthians 12:27)
description: Every member of the church matters. May God help us to see that all members of the church have gifts from the Spirit for the building up of Christ's Church.
speaker: Platt

title: #783 – For the Sake of the Gospel (1 Corinthians 9:22–23)
description: The Apostle Paul was willing to lay down his own life for the sake of the lost hearing the gospel and trusting in Jesus for salvation.
speaker: Platt

title: #782 – Building Up One Another  (1 Corinthians 8:13)
description: The Bible calls followers of Jesus to set aside their rights for the sake of others. This changes everything when we ask ourselves how can we live in a way that helps encourage others in their faith?
speaker: Platt

title: #781 – The Lord's Discipline (Proverbs 3:11–12)
description: May we learn to love the discipline of God. We know that He is ultimately for our good and for His glory.
speaker: Platt

title: #780 – Open Our Eyes (1 Corinthians 6:9–10)
description: Jesus has set us free from the penalty of sin. We have been freed to obey. May He open our eyes to all areas of our lives where we are tempted to sin against Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #779 – God's Temple (1 Corinthians 3:16–17)
description: 1 Corinthians 3 shows us that the church is a unique body because it is set apart by God to be a display of His character.
speaker: Platt

title: #778 – Dependence on God's Spirit (1 Corinthians 2:11)
description: We need the Holy Spirit to open our eyes to the truth of God's Word. May we be desperate for God's Spirit.
speaker: Platt

title: #777 – Accurately Understanding God's Word (Acts 18:26)
description: God, please help us all to grow in our understanding of Your Word. May we accurately study Your Word and accurately proclaim Your Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #776 – The Word Speeding Ahead (2 Thessalonians 3:1)
description: We want God's Word to take root in our communities where we live and we want God's Word to speed ahead to those throughout the world who have never heard of Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #775 –  Abounding in Love (1 Thessalonians 3:12–13)
description: God we pray that today we will abound in our love for the church, for Christ, and for the lost and dying world around us.
speaker: Platt

title: #774 – The Reward of Wisdom (Proverbs 2:3–5)
description: Lord help us to boast only in knowing You. We trust that knowing You is the reward of wisdom.
speaker: Platt

title: #773 – God's Word Going Forth Everywhere (1 Thessalonians 1:8)
description: Lord please cause Your Word to go forward. May Your Word not be stuck, insulated inside the walls of our church buildings, but cause it to sound forth to the ends of the earth.
speaker: Platt

title: #772 – Gospel Opportunities All Around (Acts 17:26–27)
description: God, open our eyes to the opportunities we have to share the gospel with the nations right around us. May we proclaim the gospel in our neighborhood and among the nations.
speaker: Platt

title: #771 – The Fruit of the Spirit (Galatians 5:22–23)
description: Let us pray that God will bring about this fruit in our lives. By the power of God's Spirit, may we be a people marked by this fruit.
speaker: Platt

title: #770 – Crucified with Christ (Galatians 2:20)
description: We are saved from sin by faith in Christ. The life we now live must be by faith in the Son of God who loved us and gave Himself for us.
speaker: Platt

title: #769 – Wisdom from Above (James 3:17)
description: Let's make it a daily habit that before we even get out of bed we will cry out to God to give us His wisdom.
speaker: Platt

title: #768 – Religion That is Pure and Undefiled (James 1:27)
description: Lord, please do not let us neglect what you have declared to be pure and undefiled. Help us to take responsibility for caring for orphans and widows.
speaker: Platt

title: #767 – Dwelling Secure in God (Proverbs 1:32–33)
description: May God give us grace to actively seek and pursue wisdom through His Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #766 – The Leadership of God's Spirit (Acts 16:6–8)
description: O Lord, direct our steps today for the spread of Your gospel.
speaker: Platt

title: #765 – Multitudes of Missionaries (Acts 13:4)
description: God, give us faith to pray honestly for You to call out multitudes of missionaries for the sake of Christ being praised among all nations.
speaker: Platt

title: #764 – Family Members Imprisoned for the Gospel (Acts 12:5)
description: May we be faithful to pray for our brothers and sisters throughout the world who have been imprisoned because of their devotion to Jesus Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #763 – Repentance that Leads to Life (Acts 11:18)
description: Thanks be to God for His gracious love towards all the nations. In this text we once again see the global thrust of the gospel.
speaker: Platt

title: #762 – Union with Christ (Acts 9:5)
description: We rejoice that we are united to Christ through His death and resurrection. We know that even when there are those who are against us, God is for us. He identifies with us.
speaker: Platt

title: #761 – Supernatural Forgiveness (Acts 7:60)
description: Lord, teach us to forgive those who have sinned against us. We pray that God will bring even those who are persecuting Christians to trust in Him and proclaim Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #760 – Excellence According to God's Word (Proverbs 31:10)
description: May all of our lives be marked by wisdom according to God's Word rather than the ways of the world.
speaker: Platt

title: #759 – Devotion to Prayer (Acts 6:4)
description: Lord, please teach us to pray with the kind of devotion we see in Acts 6:4.
speaker: Platt

title: #758 – They Had Been With Jesus (Acts 4:13)
description: May the conclusion of those around us be that we have been with Jesus.
speaker: Platt

title: #757 – The Spirit Dwells in You (Acts 2:1–4)
description: If you trust in Christ for salvation, you have the Spirit of God inside of you. Might this compel you to open your mouth and proclaim the good news to those around you.
speaker: Platt

title: #756 – Just the Beginning (Acts 1:1)
description: Jesus rose from the grave and sent His Spirit to be with His people. The gospel continues to go forward in the world. Acts shows us that the work of Jesus cannot be stopped.
speaker: Platt

title: #755 – All Authority Belongs to Jesus (Matthew 28:18)
description: In light of Christ's authority, we pray that God will help us to boldly proclaim the good news of Christ. We pray that the gospel of Christ's Lordship will be proclaimed among the unreached peoples of the world.
speaker: Platt

title: #754 – Life in His Name (John 20:31)
description: We have been called to experience life in Christ. May God help us to wage war on any temptation to retreat into nominal Christianity. May our lives be dictated by Christ who is our life.
speaker: Platt

title: #753 – Praying in Accordance with God's Word (Proverbs 30:32–33)
description: Father, we pray that Proverbs 30:32–33 would be realities in our lives today.
speaker: Platt

title: #752 – The Gospel Proclaimed to All Nations (Luke 24:46–47)
description: In Luke 24, Jesus makes it clear that the gospel is to be spread in all the world. May we pray to the end that God will use His church to get the gospel to all the world.
speaker: Platt

title: #751 – You will be with Me in Paradise (Luke 23:43)
description: We cannot stand before God in and of ourselves, but we rejoice that we have been saved completely by Jesus and His finished work.
speaker: Platt

title: #750 – Jesus Paid it All (Matthew 27:51)
description: Jesus gave Himself in the place of sinners to reconcile us to God. Through Christ's work, we are no longer separated from the presence of God.
speaker: Platt

title: #749 – Looking Back and Looking Forward (Matthew 26:29)
description: The Lord's Supper compels us to look back and remember what Jesus has done for us. It also causes us to look forward with great anticipation of the day when we will see Jesus face to face.
speaker: Platt

title: #748 – The Eternality of God's Word (Matthew 24:35)
description: God help us to see the supremacy of Your Word over everything else in this world.
speaker: Platt

title: #747 – Jesus Praying For Us (John 17:20–21)
description: Jesus prays for the unity of Christians. If we are not unified, we hinder the spread of the gospel.
speaker: Platt

title: #746 – Safe in God (Proverbs 29:25)
description: Do you want to live in safety and security? Don't live for the approval or applause of others.
speaker: Platt

title: #745 – I Have Overcome the World (John 16:33)
description: Do not think for a second that you are defeated. Lift up your head, for you belong to the King who has conquered death. He has overcome the world and promises to bring you into His perfect presence forever and ever.
speaker: Platt

title: #744 – Asking in Accordance with God's Word (John 15:7)
description: The key to experiencing what God wants for us in prayer is asking God in accordance with His Word. Lord, help Your Word to abide in us that we may confidently call out to You according to Your Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #743 – I Have Given You an Example (John 13:15)
description: How can you serve someone in this way today? Let's lay our lives down to serve others for the glory of God.
speaker: Platt

title: #742 – Jesus Wept (John 11:35)
description: We have a God who has come to us. He knows what it means to be greatly troubled. He is able to identify and empathize with our hurt. Jesus is the Resurrection and the Life. We know that in Christ we will be with God forever.
speaker: Platt

title: #741 – One Flock, One Shepherd (John 10:16)
description: The Good Shepherd is bringing sheep into His fold from all over the world. He has commissioned us. May we be faithful to take this good news of the Savior to the ends of the earth.
speaker: Platt

title: #740 – Unworthy Servants (Luke 17:10)
description: The posture of our lives should be one of realizing we are unworthy servants. May we humbly before our God be faithful to labor and toil in the duty God has graciously assigned us.
speaker: Platt

title: #739 – A Pretty Simple Proverb (Proverbs 28:27)
description: In our giving, we will not want. This is the antithesis of the way of this world. May God give us grace to give generously and to be content in Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #738 – I Once was Lost, but now I am Found (Luke 15:10)
description: God graciously seeks and saves the lost. We were once lost and now are found.
speaker: Platt

title: #737 – The Last Will be First (Matthew 19:30)
description: Don't buy into the ways of this world. Lay down the pursuits of this world and live as servants of the King, longing for the glory of Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #736 – Don't Underestimate God (John 6:9)
description: The picture in John 6 is that your life in the hands of Jesus can be used in ways far beyond what you can ask or imagine.Download the weekly here to follow along with each episode of...
speaker: Platt

title: #735 – Enthralled with Jesus Above All (Luke 14:26)
description: Your love for Christ should make your closest relationships in this world look like hate in comparison.
speaker: Platt

title: #734 – A Testimony Worth Telling (John 4:39)
description: An encounter with Jesus is all that is needed to be equipped to testify to the gospel of Jesus Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #733 – Our Hearts Follow Our Money (Luke 12:34)
description: If you want to know where your heart is, look at what you do with your money.
speaker: Platt

title: #732 – Faithful Friends (Proverbs 27:6)
description: We need friends who will help us see things to which we are blind. We need friends who will provide constructive criticism for our good.
speaker: Platt

title: #731 – Treasure That Lasts Forever (Mark 10:21)
description: Jesus loves us so much that He doesn't let us live for the possessions of this world. Do we believe that Jesus is worthy of being treasured more than the possessions of this world?
speaker: Platt

title: #730 – I am Sending You Out (Luke 10:3)
description: Whatever risk it involves, let's pray that God will send out laborers into the harvest realizing that we are lambs being sent out in the midst of wolves.
speaker: Platt

title: #729 – Take Jesus at His Word (Matthew 8:8–9)
description: Do you long for the faith of the centurion? Let's pray to God that He will help us to trust in His Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #728 – Do You Know Jesus? (Matthew 7:21–23)
description: This is a sobering passage where we see the need to know Christ. We cannot go through religious routine void of faith in Christ and expect to have a different outcome on the day of judgment.
speaker: Platt

title: #727 – A Paradigm for Prayer (Matthew 6:9–13)
description: Jesus teaches us to pray for God's glory, gifts, grace, and guidance.
speaker: Platt

title: #726 – Shining a Light for God's Glory (Matthew 5:16)
description: Let your light shine before others, so that they may see your good works and give glory to your Father who is in heaven.
speaker: Platt

title: #725 – A Clear Warning (Proverbs 26:12)
description: This verse warns us against wisdom in our own eyes, wisdom according to our own thoughts and ways. We must look to the all-wise God for help.
speaker: Platt

title: #724 – Bear Fruit in Keeping with Repentance (Matthew 3:8)
description: Lord, open our eyes to see areas of temptation and sin in our lives. Help us to turn from sin and to cling to You.
speaker: Platt

title: #723 – The Right to Become Children of God (John 1:12–13)
description: To all who did receive Him, who believed in His name, He gave the right to become children of God. By God's grace in Christ, we have the privilege of knowing God as Father.
speaker: Platt

title: #722 – Turn and Trust (Mark 1:14–15)
description: Mark's Gospel introduces us to Jesus proclaiming the good news of the gospel, that there is salvation for anyone who repents and believes.
speaker: Platt

title: #721 – Praying for Children (Matthew 2:16)
description: Father, cause Your church to be a reflection of Your love for the fatherless and for the vulnerable. We pray for protection for the newlyborn, the unborn, and all those who are in harm's way.
speaker: Platt

title: #720 – Righteous and Devout (Luke 2:25)
description: God, give us grace to be faithful and patient and to worship You even in the midst of our waiting.
speaker: Platt

title: #719 – My Soul Magnifies the Lord (Luke 1:46–48)
description: Let's rejoice in our Redeemer. He has looked on our sinful state and shown us grace upon grace by saving us.
speaker: Platt

title: #718 – Praying for Self-Control (Proverbs 25:28)
description: This verse highlights the destruction of lacking self-control. We need the Lord's grace to help in this battle.
speaker: Platt

title: #717 – The Sun of Righteousness (Malachi 4:2)
description: All who turn from sin and trust in Christ now know Jesus as their righteousness before God. We anticipate the day when we will fully and finally experience healing in His wings.
speaker: Platt

title: #716 – Behold, He is Coming (Malachi 3:1)
description: Malachi 3 sets the stage for Christ coming to redeem sinners and bring them back into right relationship with God. We long for His return, "Come, Lord Jesus!"
speaker: Platt

title: #715 – Faithful Both to God and to Spouse (Malachi 2:15)
description: Let's pray for spouses to be faithful to one another and to God.
speaker: Platt

title: #714 – Worthy of All Our Worship (Malachi 1:14)
description: Are we offering to God a sacrifice of worship with our lives that is pleasing to Him?
speaker: Platt

title: #713 – The Battle for Holiness (Nehemiah 13:17–18)
description: In and of yourself you will drift toward sinfulness. You need the Spirit of God and the help of God to move toward holiness.
speaker: Platt

title: #712 – Rejoicing with Great Joy (Nehemiah 12:27)
description: Let's pray that in our personal lives and when the church gathers together that we will worship God appropriately for His glory.
speaker: Platt

title: #711 – Houses Built on God's Wisdom (Proverbs 24:3–4)
description: God, please cause our houses to be built on wisdom and established with understanding. May every room in our houses be filled with knowledge of You.
speaker: Platt

title: #710 – Your Name Matters (Nehemiah 11:12)
description: You are part of a great picture that extends over centuries. Your life matters in the kingdom of God. May we labor to the end that others hear the good news and are brought into this kingdom.
speaker: Platt

title: #709 – Joy in Obligation (Nehemiah 10:32)
description: Lord, help us to delight in your statutes, love your commandments, and long for Your Word in love for You.
speaker: Platt

title: #708 – You Alone are God (Nehemiah 9:5–6)
description: God is the only God, the Creator of heaven and earth. He is worthy of the praise of all peoples.
speaker: Platt

title: #707 – Want the Book (Nehemiah 8:1)
description: We have the Word of God constantly at our fingertips. Do we want the Word of God? Do we want the Book?
speaker: Platt

title: #705 – Fight the Spiritual Battle (Nehemiah 4:17–18)
description: May God give us vigilance to seek and honor Him in everything that we do. Let's fight the spiritual battle as we live out each day of our lives.
speaker: Platt

title: #704 – Honoring Your Parents (Proverbs 23:25)
description: Pause and think right now: how can you honor your mom and dad? Lord, help us to know how to do this at every age and stage of our lives.
speaker: Platt

title: #703 – Humble Courage (Nehemiah 2:4–5)
description: May God give us grace to be obedient to Him, even in that which is difficult. We pray for humble courage in total dependence on Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #702 – He is Faithful (Esther 8:17)
description: Let's stop and pray with joy and gladness at the wonderful of the gospel. Jesus has saved us from sin and conquered death that we may live with Him forever.
speaker: Platt

title: #701 – Praying for Favor (Esther 5:2)
description: Lord give us favor that doors may be opened for the gospel to go forth and bear fruit in all of the world.
speaker: Platt

title: #700 – Longing for the Salvation of Others (Esther 4:15–16)
description: Are we willing to lay down our lives that others may know Christ? Father, help us to fast and pray with the heart of Esther.
speaker: Platt

title: #699 – The Sovereign Hand of God (Esther 2:17)
description: God is sovereign over the details of our lives. God has put you where you are right now for the spread of His renown.
speaker: Platt

title: #698 – Brokenness Over Sin (Ezra 9:3–6)
description: May we not be casual with sin, but weep over it. Praise God that there is no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.
speaker: Platt

title: #697 – A Bountiful Eye (Proverbs 22:9)
description: Father, open our eyes to those who are in need. May we seek out ways to help others and to share the good news of Christ with them.
speaker: Platt

title: #696 – Set Our Hearts on You (Ezra 7:10)
description: It is our prayer that God will set our hearts on Him that we may be obedient to proclaim the Word of Christ to others. May God's Word be constantly on our hearts and lips.
speaker: Platt

title: #695 – The Global Purpose of God (Zechariah 2:11)
description: We are all called to live for the sake of every people group on the planet, that they may know Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #694 – Great is Thy Faithfulness (Ezra 6:22)
description: Looking at God's faithfulness in the past is often a great way to grow in faith in the present.
speaker: Platt

title: #693 – Weeping Over Sin and Shouting Over Salvation (Ezra 3:11–13)
description: In many ways we have lost our capacity to weep, particularly over sin. As a result of this, there is a lack of shouting of over salvation.
speaker: Platt

title: #692 – One Leader, One King (Ezra 1:1)
description: We rest confidently in the reality that one day the True King's Word will be fulfilled and a multitude from every tribe and tongue will surround His throne.
speaker: Platt

title: #691 – Spiritual Warfare (Daniel 10:13)
description: Might our eyes be opened to the reality of spiritual warfare and the weapon we have been given to fight.
speaker: Platt

title: #690 – Victory Belongs to the Lord (Proverbs 21:31)
description: Apart from Him we can do nothing. All of our hope is in the God to whom belongs the victory.
speaker: Platt

title: #689 – More Important than Life (Daniel 6:10)
description: How important is prayer to you? Daniel was willing to risk his life to commune with God.
speaker: Platt

title: #688 – He is Able to Save (Daniel 3:28–29)
description: We have brothers and sisters throughout the world who risk their lives to worship Christ. Let's remember them in prayer, and may we live wherever we are to make the good news of Christ known.
speaker: Platt

title: #687 – Better than the Ways of the World (Daniel 1:8–9)
description: God, give us grace to be led by Your Word. May we live, not according to the ways of the world, but by the Word of God.
speaker: Platt

title: #686 – For the Sake of His Holy Name (Ezekiel 36:22–23)
description: Our motivation must be in step with God's, and His motivation is His glory covering the earth as the waters cover the sea.
speaker: Platt

title: #685 – An Urgent Message (Jeremiah 52:4)
description: Judgment is coming. Those who have trusted in Christ must realize the urgency of the gospel. May God give us grace to tell someone the glorious news of the gospel today.
speaker: Platt

title: #684 – You are Our Delight (Jeremiah 31:33)
description: God has graciously given His people new hearts. By saving us through His grace, we now long to delight in our Redeemer.
speaker: Platt

title: #683 – Wise Counsel and Guidance  (Proverbs 20:18)
description: May we surround ourselves with others who give us wise counsel, and may we, by God's grace, be able to give wise guidance to those around us.
speaker: Platt

title: #682 – The Purpose of the Lord will Stand (Proverbs 19:21)
description: It is good to know that it is only the purpose of the all-wise God that will stand. Let's submit our plans to His purpose.
speaker: Platt

title: #681 – Seek and Find (Jeremiah 29:13)
description: God, give us grace to seek and be satisfied in You. May we boast only in You.
speaker: Platt

title: #680 – Known Before we were Born (Jeremiah 1:4–5)
description: Before we were formed in the womb, we were known by God. We praise God for His love for us. May He help us to show this love for every single life in the world.
speaker: Platt

title: #679 – Saved for a Purpose (2 Kings 19:19)
description: You are not saved without reason. You have been saved so that His glory will be made known among all the peoples of the earth.
speaker: Platt

title: #678 – Devotion to God Alone (2 Kings 17:33)
description: Lord, help us to worship You and only You. Give us grace to flee the temptation of pledging our lives to anything other than You.
speaker: Platt

title: #677 – Christ, Our Shepherd and Security (Micah 5:4–5)
description: By God's grace, we dwell securely under the care of the Good Shepherd. May His name be made known to the ends of the earth.
speaker: Platt

title: #676 – The Name of the Lord is a Strong Tower (Proverbs 18:10)
description: God is our refuge and strength. May we run to Him and see that we are secure in His grace.
speaker: Platt

title: #675 – Tremble at His Word (Isaiah 66:2)
description: Lord, remove our pride and selfishness that we may be humble and contrite, trembling at Your Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #674 – Proclaiming Good News Wherever We Go (Isaiah 52:7)
description: "How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news of happiness, who publishes salvation, who says to Zion, 'Your God reigns.'"
speaker: Platt

title: #673 – Transgressions Blotted Out (Isaiah 44:22)
description: God, help us to take sin seriously but realize that you have covered our sins through Christ. We have been forgiven and freed from sin.
speaker: Platt

title: #672 – Send Me (Isaiah 6:8)
description: Father, cause the posture of our hearts be that of Isaiah. May each of us say each day, "Here I am! Send me."
speaker: Platt

title: #671 – Cry out to God (Joel 1:14)
description: Are we willing to cry out to God day and night? Lord, help us to be desperate for You.
speaker: Platt

title: #670 – Seek Me and Live (Amos 5:4)
description: Life is not found in seeking the pleasures, pursuits, and plaudits of this world. No, life is found in seeking God.
speaker: Platt

title: #669 – Allured by God's Love (Hosea 2:13–14)
description: We love Him because He first loved us. God has looked down on us and rather than condemning us, He condemned Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #668 – Repent and Believe (Jonah 3:10)
description: Anyone who turns from sin and trusts in Christ will be saved from God's judgment and will be with Him forever. Who can you share this news with today?
speaker: Platt

title: #667 – Sharing God's Love for Sinners (Jonah 1:1–3)
description: Lord, help us not to be like Jonah. Keep us from prejudice toward any people when it comes to opening our mouths and proclaiming the good news of Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #666 – One God Over All (2 Kings 5:15)
description: We are tempted to live for many things, but there is only one true God who is worthy of our worship.
speaker: Platt

title: #665 – Christ is Coming Back  (2 Kings 2:11–12)
description: There is coming a day when the trumpet will sound and Christ will come back for His bride. Until He returns, may we be faithful to Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #664 – Aligning with God's Word (1 Kings 22:12)
description: When you are in a church gathering, at a conference, or reading a book, test what you hear. If it does not align with God's Word, do not believe it.
speaker: Platt

title: #663 – You are Never Alone (1 Kings 19:4–5)
description: Even in the depths of discouragement and depression, God is with you. Know that in whatever you are walking through, God has not stopped loving you.
speaker: Platt

title: #662 – Honoring God and Our Families (Proverbs 17:6)
description: May we bring glory to God in the way that we care for our families.
speaker: Platt

title: #661 – The Lord, He is God (1 Kings 18:37–39)
description: We pray in faith that God will call His people according to His purpose. Let's pray that by God's grace many will turn in Christ declaring, "The Lord, He is God."
speaker: Platt

title: #660 – Hearing and Doing the Word (1 Kings 17:5)
description: May we, like Elijah, hear God's Word and obey God's Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #659 – Wholly Following Christ (1 Kings 11:6)
description: Let's pray that God will help us not to let sin have a foothold in our lives. May we wholly follow Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #658 – Fixing Our Eyes on God (Proverbs 31:25)
description: We are prone to be anxious, but when we fear God we do not have to be afraid of the future.
speaker: Platt

title: #657 – Using Words Wisely (Proverbs 16:24)
description: Lord, help us to build up others with our words today.
speaker: Platt

title: #656 – Honoring God with Our Firstfruits (Proverbs 3:9)
description: With all that God has given you—regardless of what or how much—see it as a gift from Him and belonging to Him to be used for His honor and glory.
speaker: Platt

title: #655 – Unrighteous Anger (Proverbs 16:32)
description: We often view anger as a display of strength and power. But the Bible says that it is better to be slow to anger and self-controlled. May we examine our lives for areas where we struggle with unrighteous anger toward one another.
speaker: Platt

title: #654 – Wisdom Implies Humility (Proverbs 1:5)
description: The foolish think they have it figured out. We must humbly submit to God's Word knowing that there we obtain guidance.
speaker: Platt

title: #653 – God's Glory Among the Nations (1 Kings 8:41–43)
description: Even tucked away in 1 Kings, we see God's heart for the nations. He is worthy of the praise of all the peoples on the earth.
speaker: Platt

title: #652 – In Awe of God's Wisdom (1 Kings 3:28)
description: We lack wisdom. May we constantly pray to God that we may walk in His wisdom.
speaker: Platt

title: #651 – Living with Courage (1 Kings 2:2–3)
description: Let's trust God's Word even when it is not easy, knowing that we will experience God's goodness.
speaker: Platt

title: #650 – The Song of Creation (Psalm 148:7–8)
description: All of creation obeys its Maker. May we join in this song ascribing to God the honor that only He is due.
speaker: Platt

title: #649 – Knitted Together by God (Psalm 139:13–14)
description: We praise God for crafting us together. He has made everyone fearfully and wonderfully in His image. May we promote the beauty and wonder of Psalm 139 throughout the world.
speaker: Platt

title: #648 – A Simple and Significant Verse (Proverbs 15:22)
description: As we make decisions, it is good to live in community with those who fear God and are depending on Him through His Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #647 – The Beauty of God's Word (Psalm 119)
description: There is so much treasure to be found in Psalm 119. Let's pray some of these verses over our lives.
speaker: Platt

title: #646 – Storing up God's Word (Psalm 119:11)
description: How are you internalizing Scripture? O God, make us a people who store up Your Word in our hearts.
speaker: Platt

title: #645 – Delighting in God's Word  (Psalm 1:1–2)
description: We pray that by God's grace we will saturate our souls with meditation on God's Word day and night.
speaker: Platt

title: #644 – Who Shall Ascend the Hill of the Lord? (Psalm 24:3–4)
description: In Christ we are made clean. Through His merits, we can draw near to the throne of God and ascend the hill of the Lord.
speaker: Platt

title: #643 – Appealing to God for Mercy (Psalm 51:1)
description: We are sinners who defy God, yet He invites us to appeal for mercy because of His steadfast love.
speaker: Platt

title: #642 – Displeasing God (2 Samuel 11:27)
description: Lord help us to see areas of our lives where we are not pleasing You.
speaker: Platt

title: #641 – A Tranquil Heart (Proverbs 14:30)
description: In Christ we can be free from bone-rotting envy. May God give us grace to rest in Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #640 – The Kindness of the King (2 Samuel 9:7–8)
description: We who were once enemies of God have been invited to eat at His table now, for all our days in this life, and for all of eternity.We who were once enemies of God have been invited to eat at His table now, for all our days in this life, and for ...
speaker: Platt

title: #639 – Prayer Based on Promises (2 Samuel 7:27–29)
description: Lord, help us to trust Your promises as we learn to pray with boldness, courage, and faith according to Your Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #638 – The Lord is Our Shepherd (Psalm 23:1–3)
description: Why does God lead us in paths of righteousness? For His name's sake. He leads us for our good and ultimately for His glory.
speaker: Platt

title: #637 – Live Looking to God (2 Samuel 2:1)
description: May we humbly go before God asking for Him to guide our every step, trusting that this will bring glory to Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #636 – He Will Provide (1 Samuel 28:6–7)
description: God, help us truly to seek You alone knowing that You will provide and draw us into deeper intimacy with You.
speaker: Platt

title: #635 – Trust in God's Timing (1 Samuel 24:7)
description: We are prone to try and take matters into our own hands. We need wisdom and patience to walk in step with the Spirit and in obedience to God's Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #634 – Walk with the Wise (Proverbs 13:20)
description: Let's pray to the end that we will be surrounded by wise companions who delight in God and His Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #633 – The Danger of Deception (1 Samuel 21:1–2)
description: Might we in our own lives take sin as seriously as God does.
speaker: Platt

title: #632 – God upon the Throne (1 Samuel 19:10)
description: Jesus has conquered sin and death. He rules and reigns even now. We know that one day our suffering will pass and we will be in His arms for all of eternity.
speaker: Platt

title: #631 – The Danger of Defying God (1 Samuel 17:26)
description: The Philistines defied God. David trusted God and lived for the glory of the Lord. May we see the futility of defying God and grow in our dependence on Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #630 – God Looks on the Heart (1 Samuel 16:7)
description: Father, please make our hearts to be more like yours. May we grow in our affection for Christ and for others.
speaker: Platt

title: #629 – After God's Heart (1 Samuel 13:13–14)
description: The way to life is living according to God's Word. Lord, help us to trust that following You is for our good.
speaker: Platt

title: #628 – A Posture of Humility (1 Samuel 9:21)
description: May we lay our pride down daily before God. Let's pray for lives that are marked by humility in light of God's grace.
speaker: Platt

title: #627 – A Wise Man Listens to Advice (Proverbs 12:15)
description: We all have blind spots. God uses others in our lives to help us see that which we cannot see on our own.
speaker: Platt

title: #626 – Speak, Lord, for Your Servant Hears (1 Samuel 3:9)
description: God has given us His Word. We do not have to wait for some audible voice. Amid the busyness of our week, may our lives be dictated by listening to God's Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #625 – Children Belong to the Lord (1 Samuel 1:27–28)
description: Children are wonderfully made by God and belong to Him. May we pray for children in the church and throughout the world to be saved by God's grace through Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #624 – Tragedy into Triumph (Ruth 4:14)
description: Know that even through times of tragedy, loss, and brokenness, you can trust God. Suffering in this world will be far outweighed by glory that is to come.
speaker: Platt

title: #623 – A Picture of Redemption (Ruth 2:20)
description: Jesus has the right, resources, and resolve to redeem us from sin and bring us into the family of God. All glory be to Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #622 – The Power of God's Presence (Judges 16:20)
description: If you are in Christ, you are not alone. God will never leave you nor forsake you.
speaker: Platt

title: #621 – A Dangerous Phrase (Judges 14:1–3)
description: God, save us from doing what seems right in our own eyes. Please help us to see through the lens of Your Word and live according to it.
speaker: Platt

title: #620 – The Grave Has Been Conquered (Romans 10:9)
description: If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God has raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.
speaker: Platt

title: #619 – Apart from Him We Can Do Nothing (Judges 6:15)
description: God has called each of us to do that which can only be accomplished in His power at work in us.
speaker: Platt

title: #618 – For God So Loved the World (Judges 4:1)
description: We deserve judgment, but Jesus has taken this judgment upon Himself. Through Christ's work we have everlasting life.
speaker: Platt

title: #617 – Passing the Gospel to the Next Generation (Judges 2:10)
description: The book of Judges shows us the danger of failing to pass the gospel on to the generation that will follow.
speaker: Platt

title: #616 – We Will Serve the Lord (Joshua 24:14–15)
description: Our lives should be marked by devotion to God. May God use our lives today as His servants for His purposes.
speaker: Platt

title: #615 – The Seriousness of Sin (Joshua 7:1)
description: When we sin against God, it does not just affect us. Lord, help us to see the seriousness of sin and run to the Savior.
speaker: Platt

title: #614 – Are You on God's Side? (Joshua 5:13–14)
description: May we keep from thinking that this life is primarily about us. God teach us to pray according to Your will. Help us to seek Your will above all else.
speaker: Platt

title: #613 – Capturing Souls (Proverbs 11:30)
description: When we share the gospel we are helping lead others to a road of eternal life with God. May we point people from death to life.
speaker: Platt

title: #612 – Consecrated for Christ (Joshua 3:5)
description: May we be constantly consecrated before God. Lord, set us apart daily to be used to play our part in the accomplishment of Your puurpose.
speaker: Platt

title: #611 – Meditating on God's Word (Joshua 1:8)
description: We want good success according to God's Word and not according to this world. Might God make us a people who are marked by meditation on His Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #610 – Knowing God Face to Face (Deuteronomy 34:10)
description: Through Christ's work on the cross in our place, we are afforded intimacy with God. We can know Him face to face.
speaker: Platt

title: #609 – Choose Life (Deuteronomy 30:15–20)
description: God help us to choose life and to spread life for the glory of Jesus Christ. May we learn from the foolishness of those who have gone before us.
speaker: Platt

title: #608 – Not by Bread Alone (Deuteronomy 8:3)
description: Man does not live by bread alone but by every word that comes from the mouth of God.
speaker: Platt

title: #607 – God's Word on Display (Deuteronomy 6:6–9)
description: Look for opportunities to constantly speak of God's Word. Lord, help us to saturate our public lives with Your Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #606 – The Harvest is Plentiful (Proverbs 10:5)
description: Let's pray for laborers to be sent by God out into the harvest.
speaker: Platt

title: #605 – The God who Fights for You (Deuteronomy 3:22)
description: How do you fight fear? By trusting in the God who fights for you. If God is for us, who can be against us?
speaker: Platt

title: #604 – Called and Equipped (Deuteronomy 1:17)
description: We cannot fulfill what God has called us to on our own. However, by God's grace and power at work within us, we can. All glory be to Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #603 – God's Character on Display (Numbers 35:34)
description: Jesus has commissioned us to go to the nations. Let's pray that God's character will be on display in the church and that God's glory will be made known in places where Christ has not yet been praised.
speaker: Platt

title: #602 – When the End Doesn't Justify the Means (Numbers 20:10–11)
description: Like Moses, there is a temptation for us not to do God's work God's way. Lord please help us to value Your Word more than a pragmatism that sees efficiency and effectiveness as supreme.
speaker: Platt

title: #601 – He Sees Our Hearts (Numbers 16:4–5)
description: May God deliver us from the temptation to make it look as though we are holy instead of actually pursuing holiness. God help us to be holy before You.
speaker: Platt

title: #600 – Choose Faith over Fear (Numbers 14:9)
description: We are prone to be anxious and afraid. The exhortation of Scripture is to take God at His Word. Lord, help us to trust in You. Replace our fear with faith.
speaker: Platt

title: #599 – Knowledge of the Holy One (Proverbs 9:10)
description: Wisdom flows from seeing God for who He is and responding to Him appropriately. May God help us to have a perspective that is centered on the knowledge of Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #598 – Empowered by the Spirit (Numbers 11:29)
description: We have been empowered by the Spirit of God to speak and proclaim His Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #597 – Humble Confession (Leviticus 26:40–42)
description: What do you need to confess before God right now? Lord, help us to walk in constant confession of sin.
speaker: Platt

title: #596 – Observe All My Statutes (Leviticus 19:37)
description: We go to God's Word, not looking for suggestions to consider, but for commands to obey.
speaker: Platt

title: #595 – Covered by Christ (Leviticus 16:34)
description: Every bitter thought and every sinful deed has been covered by Christ's work on the cross. Trust in Him alone to save you from your sins.
speaker: Platt

title: #594 – Our God is Glorious (Leviticus 9:23)
description: May we long to see more and more of God's glory. Lord, forgive us for neglecting your glory.
speaker: Platt

title: #593 – The Guidance of God (Exodus 40:36–38)
description: In these verses we see a picture of God leading His people step by step. He has given us His Spirit and leads us today.
speaker: Platt

title: #592 – Loved by Wisdom (Proverbs 8:17)
description: May our lives be characterized by a God-centered and Bible-saturated wisdom. Let's pray to the end that we will walk wisely in every area of our lives.
speaker: Platt

title: #591 – Reflecting the Glory of God (Exodus 34:34–35)
description: We become like what we behold. The more we focus on Christ, the more He will be reflected in our lives.
speaker: Platt

title: #590 – Selfless Intercession (Exodus 32:32)
description: We are prone to stay silent in fear when it comes to sharing the gospel. Let's put ourselves aside, calling out to God on behalf of others that we may boldly proclaim Christ to them.
speaker: Platt

title: #589 – Set Apart for God's Purpose (Exodus 30:30)
description: Let us pray that God will set our lives apart for service to Him. May our lives look entirely different from the world around us for the glory of Jesus Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #588 – Guard Against Casually Approaching God (Exodus 28:35)
description: We are tempted to neglect the seriousness of the privilege of calling upon God. May God help us to have right reverence when it comes to approaching Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #587 – Nothing in My Hand I Bring  (Exodus 26:34)
description: Access has been granted to us—by the mercy of God—to come to Him. He has made a way for us to be accepted in His sight.
speaker: Platt

title: #586 – A Substitute Sacrifice (Exodus 24:8)
description: The blood of Christ has sealed the New Covenant. Thanks be to God that we are made clean in Christ and are united to Him forever.
speaker: Platt

title: #585 – A Deadly Allure (Proverbs 7:21–23)
description: Let's pray that God will keep us from toying with sin. May we take God at His Word and flee from adultery and every temptation.
speaker: Platt

title: #584 – No Other gods Before Me (Exodus 20:3)
description: May God help us not to exchange His glory for lesser things. God alone is worthy of our ultimate devotion.
speaker: Platt

title: #583 – God Our Sustenance (Exodus 16:15)
description: God is our provider and our ultimate source of sustenance.
speaker: Platt

title: #582 – A Picture of God's Power (Exodus 14:31)
description: When sinners turn from sin and trust in Jesus, we see God's power to save on display. Only He can transform lives by bringing sinners from death to life.
speaker: Platt

title: #581 – The Spotless Sacrifice (Exodus 12:23)
description: The only way to be delivered from the judgment we deserve is to take refuge in Jesus Christ. He is the spotless sacrifice.
speaker: Platt

title: #580 – The Root of Every Sin (Exodus 10:3)
description: Pride is on display when we sin against God. We think we know what is best. The antidote to sin is humility, so let us ask God for this.
speaker: Platt

title: #579 – The Danger of Self-Exaltation (Exodus 9:17)
description: In each of our lives, we are tempted to live for our purposes instead of God's praise.
speaker: Platt

title: #578 – A List Like This (Proverbs 6:16–19)
description: Let us ask God to help us to hate what He hates. May God purify and sanctify us so that none of these things characterize our lives.
speaker: Platt

title: #577 – He Hears Your Cries (Exodus 6:5)
description: God will show Himself faithful to all His promises. Even in the valley of the shadow of death, He is faithful.
speaker: Platt

title: #576 – The Sovereignty of God and Man's Responsibility  (Exodus 4:21)
description: Thanks be to God that, in this mystery of His sovereignty and man's responsibility, He has provided our salvation in Jesus.
speaker: Platt

title: #575 – "I AM" Sent Me (Exodus 3:14)
description: God is not dependent on anyone or anything. He is immutable, and He is with you.
speaker: Platt

title: #574 – Bound for the Promised Land (Genesis 50:25)
description: Everything looks very different when your eyes are fixed, not just on today, but on what will matter ten trillion years from now.
speaker: Platt

title: #573 – Let the Nations be Glad (Genesis 49:10)
description: We take the gospel to the nations because to Him shall be the obedience of all peoples. Jesus is worthy of the praise of every tribe and tongue.
speaker: Platt

title: #572 – God Keeps His Promises (Genesis 46:27)
description: The promises of God are sure. They are surer than anything else in this world. You can count on His Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #571 – Intoxicated in Love (Proverbs 5:18–19)
description: Let us pray for ever-increasing intoxication to mark marriages.
speaker: Platt

title: #570 – Not You but God (Genesis 45:8)
description: Joseph realizes that his brothers meant evil, but God meant it for good. Questions may arise as we journey through life in a fallen world, but the conclusion is clear: Trust in Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #569 – Our Good and His Glory (Genesis 42:6)
description: And we know that for those who love God all things work together for good, for those who are called according to His purpose.
speaker: Platt

title: #568 – Fruitful in Affliction (Genesis 41:52)
description: Affliction can be a field where fruit grows. Affliction is unavoidable in a fallen world, but even in this, God can cause your life to bear fruit.
speaker: Platt

title: #567 – You are Not Alone (Genesis 39:20–23)
description: Regardless of the circumstances in your life, you can hold fast to the promise of God that He is with you. Know that you can trust Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #566 – Pointing to Christ (Genesis 37:26–27)
description: Always see the Bible in the context of a bigger story of redemption in Jesus Christ. The story of your life is intended to point people to the story of God's love in Jesus.
speaker: Platt

title: #565 – A New Name (Genesis 35:10–12)
description: Just as God gave Jacob a new name, He is gracious to us and has provided our salvation in Christ. May we never cease to be overwhelmed by God's grace that He has poured out on us.
speaker: Platt

title: #564 – Get Wisdom (Proverbs 4:7–8)
description: It is wise to seek wisdom. In whatever we do today, we need wisdom. We are driven to pray to this end.
speaker: Platt

title: #563 – Boldly Asking for Blessing (Genesis 32:26)
description: We see Jacob wrestling with God in Genesis 32. Might we boldly seek God's face, crying out to Him day and night.
speaker: Platt

title: #562 – From Barrenness to Blessing (Genesis 30:22)
description: Let us pray in a multitude of ways that God will take barrenness and turn it into blessing.
speaker: Platt

title: #561 – Communion with God (Genesis 28:16–17)
description: Christ dying on the cross in our place has given us access to God. We constantly have communion with God.
speaker: Platt

title: #560 – The Forfeits of Sin (Genesis 25:31–34)
description: We are prone to exchange intimacy with God for immediate gratification. God, help us to value intimacy with You over the fleeting pleasure of this world.
speaker: Platt

title: #559 – Grant Us Success Today (Genesis 24:12)
description: We are hopeless apart from God. We need His intervention daily. Let us pray that God will continually conform us more into the image of Christ each day.
speaker: Platt

title: #558 – His Only Son (Genesis 22:2)
description: God sent Jesus to be the substitutionary sacrifice for us. God's only Son was given to atone for our sins. See the love of God for you.
speaker: Platt

title: #557 – Help Us to Trust in You (Proverbs 3:5–6)
description: Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge Him, and He shall make straight your paths.
speaker: Platt

title: #556 – Praying for Healing (Genesis 20:17)
description: We pray to the God who is sovereign over the health of everyone. It is entirely right to pray in faith for healing. May God help us to pray in faith, trusting that He knows what is best.
speaker: Platt

title: #555 – The Privilege of Intercession (Genesis 18:22)
description: God has ordained prayer as a means by which He acts. God responds to our praying so may we be encouraged by the privilege we have in prayer.
speaker: Platt

title: #554 – God's Grace for the Nations (Genesis 17:5)
description: God wants His glory to be made known among all the nations. May we be faithful to pray for the spread of the gospel to the ends of the earth.
speaker: Platt

title: #553 – God is Committed to You (Genesis 15:18)
description: God is faithful to His promises. Christ's commitment to His bride is sealed by the blood He shed on the cross.
speaker: Platt

title: #552 – A Willingness to Obey (Genesis 12:4)
description: Let us pray that God will help us to value obedience to Him above all else.
speaker: Platt

title: #551 – My Eye Sees You (Job 42:5–6)
description: Might we know and trust God more as a result of walking through pain, sorrow, and suffering.
speaker: Platt

title: #550 – The Paths of the Righteous (Proverbs 2:20)
description: God, help us to walk in the way of the good and keep to the paths of the righteous. We are prone to wander, but God will keep us for our good and His glory.
speaker: Platt

title: #549 – The Author of all Wisdom (Job 38:36)
description: While we lack wisdom, knowledge, and perspective, we can always trust God and His perfect wisdom.
speaker: Platt

title: #548 – Blessed be the Name of the Lord (Job 1:20–22)
description: Let's pray for grace to respond to sorrow and sadness with worship. Through Christ, we know that even death does not have the final say. May we worship in the face of sorrow and death.
speaker: Platt

title: #547 – Praying for the Unreached (Genesis 9:7)
description: God wants His grace and goodness to fill the earth. We must devote ourselves to getting God's gospel where Christ has not been proclaimed.
speaker: Platt

title: #546 – Sin is Serious (Genesis 7:20–22)
description: The wages of sin is death. Thanks be to God for His mercy that Jesus has endured the flood of God's wrath due us. We have been freed and forgiven.
speaker: Platt

title: #545 – Seek God in Worship (Genesis 4:26)
description: When people call upon the Lord there is grace, mercy, hope, and reconciliation to be found.
speaker: Platt

title: #544 – Multiply and Fill the Earth (Genesis 1:28)
description: Christians are commanded to take the gospel to image bearers who have not trusted in Christ, that they too may have salvation and be conformed more into the image of Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #543 – The Beginning of Wisdom (Proverbs 1:7)
description: God-fearing worship leads to God-given wisdom. Wisdom begins with worship of God. We will only see things in the world wisely when we seek God worshipfully.
speaker: Platt

title: #542 – Yet I Will Rejoice in the Lord (Habakkuk 3:17–18)
description: Even in the midst of great sorrow and suffering, because of Christ conquering sin and death, we can take joy in the God of our salvation.
speaker: Platt

title: #541 – As the Waters Cover the Sea (Habakkuk 2:14)
