description: As Christians we have confidence that a day is coming when the knowledge of the glory of the Lord will cover the earth as the waters cover the sea.
speaker: Platt

title: #540 – God Hears Our Cries (Habakkuk 1:6)
description: We can pray honestly before God knowing that He cares for us even when we do not understand.
speaker: Platt

title: #539 – Marriage and Family According to God's Word (Numbers 36:6)
description: We live in a culture that is very confused about marriage and family. May the marriages and families of Christians be directed by God's Word for the good of the church and the glory of Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #538 – Freedom in Christ (Numbers 35:28)
description: What can free us from the judgment we deserve? The death of our Great High Priest frees us from bondage to sin. Jesus atones for all our sins and has reconciled us to God.
speaker: Platt

title: #537 – Unique Stewardship (Numbers 34:1–2)
description: May God help us to glorify Him with all that He has entrusted to us wherever we find ourselves in this life.
speaker: Platt

title: #536 – God's Loving Leadership (Numbers 33:1–2)
description: It is humbling to reflect upon how God has faithfully directed our steps. May God give us grace to trust Him for all our days.
speaker: Platt

title: #535 – Sin Will Find You Out (Numbers 32:23)
description: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us of our sins and cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
speaker: Platt

title: #534 – Vengeance Belongs to God (Numbers 31:1)
description: We look to God as the ultimate Judge who will never let us down and will ultimately bring about justice.
speaker: Platt

title: #533 – Praying for Marriages (Numbers 30:16)
description: We pray for God's grace and mercy to cause marriages to thrive all throughout the church.
speaker: Platt

title: #532 – Intentional Rest and Focus on God (Numbers 29:1)
description: What intentional regular focused rest are you getting in your life? We need rest from ordinary work and focused time crying out to Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #530 – Qualified by the Spirit (Numbers 27:18)
description: All of God's people are empowered by the Spirit of God. We have the very Spirit of God indwelling us. May we live today in light of this reality.
speaker: Platt

title: #529 – Obey God (Numbers 26:64–65)
description: God help us to obey you. Keep us from disobedience. May we have courage to trust and follow You.
speaker: Platt

title: #528 – Jealous for His Glory (Numbers 25:10–11)
description: The beauty of the gospel is that God shows jealousy for His glory by showering love on us through Christ's finished work.
speaker: Platt

title: #526 – The Immutability of God (Numbers 23:19)
description: We are fallible, but God is not. He is perfect in all of His ways, and what He says is always true.
speaker: Platt

title: #525 – Guard Against Greed (Numbers 22:21)
description: We must never be driven by desire for more money at the expense of faithfulness to God.
speaker: Platt

title: #524 – Look and Live (Numbers 21:8–9)
description: We find life by looking to a picture of death. Jesus went to the cross to bear our sins and die the death we deserve. Only in Him do we find life.
speaker: Platt

title: #523 – Pray for Leaders (Numbers 20:12)
description: The mantle of leadership has been given by God to be stewarded under His authority.
speaker: Platt

title: #522 – The Clean for the Unclean (Numbers 19:7)
description: Jesus has exposed Himself fully to the stain of our sin. He became unclean so that you and I could be made clean.
speaker: Platt

title: #521 – Give Generously (Numbers 18:25–26)
description: All Christians are to give sacrificially and generously for the building up of the church and the spread of the gospel.
speaker: Platt

title: #520 – Everything Depends on Jesus (Numbers 17:8)
description: Only in Christ can sinners find righteousness and life. Let us pray that every facet of our lives will be marked by total identification in Jesus.
speaker: Platt

title: #519 – Standing in the Gap (Numbers 16:48)
description: May we be a people who stand in the gap interceding for others. Might we pray for those around us and throughout the world who have not testified to the goodness of God's Son.
speaker: Platt

title: #518 – A God-Centered Perspective (Numbers 15:32–35)
description: We have too small a view of the holiness of God and the sinfulness of man. Father, help us by your grace to flee from sin and run to You.
speaker: Platt

title: #517 – Faith over Fear (Numbers 14:31–33)
description: Fear keeps us from experiencing all that God wants us to experience. Let us pray that God will deliver us from fear that we may walk in obedience to Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #516 – A Picture of Faith (Numbers 13:30)
description: Faith believes the Word of God, faith trusts the power of God, and faith is willing to obey God's Word. May we be men and women who take God at His Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #515 – Humility and Faithfulness (Numbers 12:3–8)
description: The path to intimacy with God is paved by humility before Him. Let us pray that God will remove pride from us and that we will be found faithful in all that has been given to us.
speaker: Platt

title: #514 – More than Able (Numbers 11:23)
description: Our God is sovereign over all and is more than able to do all that He desires for His glory.
speaker: Platt

title: #513 – Sound the Trumpet (Numbers 10:10)
description: May we be a people who are constantly crying out to God.
speaker: Platt

title: #512 – Hear the Word of the Lord (Numbers 9:8)
description: In all of the decisions we have to make, let us look to God and His Word for wisdom.
speaker: Platt

title: #511 – Gifts to the Church (Numbers 8:19)
description: All Christians have been given to the church as a gift from God for the good of the church and the glory of Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #510 – God Speaks Through His Word (Numbers 7:89)
description: When we open up the Bible we find the very words of God. May God help us to focus on His Word and meditate on it day and night.
speaker: Platt

title: #509 – Blessed and Kept in Grace and Peace (Numbers 6:24–26)
description: This passage beckons a confident comfort for followers of Christ. We are blessed and kept by God. He is gracious to us and has given us His peace.
speaker: Platt

title: #508 – Jesus Cleanses the Unclean (Numbers 5:1–4)
description: Jesus alone is able to take the most unclean and make them clean. He has taken our sins upon Himself to make wretched sinners clean in Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #507 – Every Member is Gifted (Numbers 4:49)
description: Take comfort in the truth that every member of the body matters. You have been gifted for the building up of the church and the spread of the gospel.
speaker: Platt

title: #506 – The Perfect High Priest (Numbers 3:2–4)
description: Jesus paid the price for our sins and has made us right before God. We are commissioned now as a royal priesthood to proclaim the grace of Christ in all the world.
speaker: Platt

title: #505 – Centered on God (Numbers 2:1–2)
description: May every part of our lives revolve around the presence and glory of God. Lord, help us to live with our eyes fixed on You.
speaker: Platt

title: #504 – All that God Commanded (Numbers 1:54)
description: It should be our prayer that God will help us not to live according to our ways but to obey all that He has commanded.
speaker: Platt

title: #503 – Advent: He will Save His People from Their Sins (Matthew 1:21)
description: Praise God for saving us through Jesus Christ. On this Christmas, let us pray for the spread of this good news to the ends of the earth.
speaker: Platt

title: #502 – Advent: The Alpha and the Omega (Revelation 1:8)
description: The child in the manger is God. He has existed for all time and will reign forever as Lord Almighty.
speaker: Platt

title: #501 – Advent: A Great High Priest (Hebrews 4:14–16)
description: Because of Christ fulfilling all righteousness and dying in our place at the cross, we can boldly approach the throne of grace in our time of need.
speaker: Platt

title: #500 – Advent: For Your Sake He Became Poor (2 Corinthians 8:9)
description: Let's be intentional to turn our attention during this Advent season toward those in urgent physical need around us. May we be compelled by the Spirit of God in us to give sacrificially.
speaker: Platt

title: #499 – Advent: The Most Important Message (1 Corinthians 15:3–4)
description: Christ died for our sins and rose from the grave in victory. Let's pray that God will give us boldness to proclaim this message of first importance.
speaker: Platt

title: #498 – Advent: Lord of All (Romans 10:12–13)
description: Salvation is available for anyone who will trust in Christ. May God use us to make His gospel known in our neighborhoods and among the nations.
speaker: Platt

title: #497 – Advent: The Word Became Flesh (John 1:14)
description: The most astounding reality in the world is that God became flesh and dwelt among us. Praise God that we have glimpsed His glory full of grace and truth in the person of Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #496 – Advent: They were Writing about Me  (Luke 24:24–27)
description: The whole Bible is about Jesus. Everything on the landscape of human history revolves around Him. His first coming changed everything, and His second coming will consummate everything.
speaker: Platt

title: #495 – Advent: Divine Appointment (Luke 2:4–7)
description: As we think about the coming of Christ this season, be amazed by the promises that led to the birth, life, death, and resurrection of Christ. All of this happened just as God had said.
speaker: Platt

title: #494 – Advent: He Came to Serve You (Mark 10:45)
description: Jesus came not to be served but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many. Praise God that He is where our help comes from for all our days.
speaker: Platt

title: #493 – Advent: The Wonder of the Incarnation (Matthew 1:20)
description: The incarnation should compel us worship in awe that God has provided a way to reconcile us to Himself in Jesus.
speaker: Platt

title: #492 – Advent: Born a Child and yet a King (Micah 5:2)
description: Jesus is a perfect ruler who has always been and forever will be. He humbled Himself by becoming obedient to the point of death. He came to save people from every tribe and tongue.
speaker: Platt

title: #491 – Advent: The Reality of Restoration (Amos 9:11)
description: God is gradually conforming us more into the image of Christ. One day this rebuilding and repairing process will be complete. We will be free from sin and see God as He is.
speaker: Platt

title: #490 – Advent: An Everlasting Covenant (Jeremiah 32:40)
description: All who trust in Christ are brought into a relationship with God that will last forever. Right now and always, God is working for your good.
speaker: Platt

title: #489 – Advent: Man of Sorrows  (Isaiah 53:2–4)
description: Jesus was smitten by God and afflicted. Humanly speaking, there was nothing that would draw us to Him. He became like us yet was without sin. He has conquered sin and death and is seated at the right hand of the Majesty on high.
speaker: Platt

title: #488 – Advent: Comforted in Christ (Isaiah 40:1–2)
description: There is no condemnation for us in Christ because Christ was condemned in our place. We deserve judgment, but in Christ we receive comfort for today and for all eternity.
speaker: Platt

title: #487 – Advent: The Fully Obedient Son (1 Kings 9:4–5)
description: Because of Christ's sinlessness, He is the qualified substitute. Christ's death in our place makes us right before God and frees us from sin. Let's pray that God will continue to conform us into the image of Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #486 – Advent: His Kingdom is Forever  (2 Samuel 7:12–13)
description: Kingdoms rise and kingdoms fall, but the rule and reign of Christ will never end.
speaker: Platt

title: #485 – Advent: A Flawed Family Tree and a Faithful God (Ruth 4:13–17)
description: Let us pray that God will cause His gospel to go forth and bear fruit in all the world, that His kingdom will continue to expand.
speaker: Platt

title: #484 – Advent: The One True King  (Judges 21:25)
description: The people of God could not find a ruler who could satisfy their longings. Jesus Christ came as the King of kings whose ways are right and ultimately for our good. In Him our deepest needs are met.
speaker: Platt

title: #483 – Advent: Until the Son of God Appears (Numbers 24:17)
description: The Old Testament anticipates the coming of a perfect King. Christ fulfilled this prophecy, and He rules over us as our King and Savior.
speaker: Platt

title: #482 – Advent: Out of Bondage (Exodus 15:19)
description: Exodus anticipates Christ's coming to save sinners from ultimate slavery so they can experience ultimate freedom.
speaker: Platt

title: #481 – Advent: A Promise Fulfilled (Genesis 15:1–5)
description: God fulfilled His promise to Abram as Christ died and rose from the grave that sinners from every tribe and tongue may turn from sin and trust in Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #480 – Advent: Sin and the Hope of a Savior (Genesis 3:1–6)
description: Adam and Eve sinned in the garden, but God graciously promised that He would send a Savior to remedy the curse of sin and reconcile sinners to Himself.
speaker: Platt

title: #478 – Worship Him Alone (Jeremiah 51:15–17)
description: We are quick to give away our worship to things that are unworthy of our affection. Let us call on God to guard us from idolatry that we may worship Him alone, the one true God.
speaker: Platt

title: #479 – God's Word Will Always Prove True (Jeremiah 52:4)
description: All that Jeremiah prophesied proved true. The grass withers, the flower fades, but the Word of our God will stand forever.
speaker: Platt

title: #477 – God's Wrath is Real (Jeremiah 50:25)
description: We need a right view of God's wrath. Jesus has endured the wrath due sinners. God's wrath is real but He has provided a substitute for those who trust in Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #476 – Don't Trust in Fleeting Things (Jeremiah 49:4)
description: Trusting in possessions or position in this world is a recipe for disaster. God help us not to boast in anything other than Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #475 – The Effects of Sin on Children (Jeremiah 48:4)
description: The effects of sin and oppression and injustice and war in the world do not just impact adults—they impact children as well.
speaker: Platt

title: #474 – Interceding on Behalf of Sinners (Jeremiah 47:6)
description: God's judgment is coming upon sinners, and we are driven to pray and plead for God's mercy, to intercede on their behalf.
speaker: Platt

title: #473 – God's Gracious Discipline (Jeremiah 46:28)
description: May we receive God's discipline and respond to it in a way that glorifies Him, knowing that it is ultimately good for us.
speaker: Platt

title: #472 – Save Us from Focus on Ourselves (Jeremiah 45:5)
description: God, help us to live with urgency for others today that we may contend for the faith.
speaker: Platt

title: #470 – Examine Your Life (Jeremiah 43:4)
description: In what areas of your life are you directly disobeying God's Word? Lord, help us to trust and obey You.
speaker: Platt

title: #469 – His Ways More Than Ours (Jeremiah 42:20–21)
description: Do we really want to obey God, or do we hope that God will bless what we want to do? He knows what is best for us. God, help us to long for your ways and to delight in You.
speaker: Platt

title: #468 – The Severity of Selfishness (Jeremiah 41:2)
description: We are tempted to look out for our own interests rather than the interests of others. May we wage war on selfishness for the good of others and the glory of Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #467 – God's Infallible Word (Jeremiah 40:2)
description: God help us to believe Your Word even when we are tempted to doubt and help us to proclaim it when we are tempted to be silent.
speaker: Platt

title: #466 – A Pretty Simple Truth (Jeremiah 39:18)
description: The essence of the Christian message is trust in God and be saved.
speaker: Platt

title: #465 – You can Trust Him (Jeremiah 38:6)
description: Even when all around your soul gives way, Jesus is your hope and stay. Even in the mud, you can rest in Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #464 – A Prayer for the Persecuted (Jeremiah 37:15)
description: Like Jeremiah, we have brothers and sisters throughout the world who are imprisoned because of their faith. Let's pray for them to persevere that the gospel may continue to go forth and bear fruit in all the world.
speaker: Platt

title: #463 – Hear from God (Jeremiah 36:11–12)
description: We need God's Word from the time we wake up until we lay down again at night. May we be a people who submit to His authority.
speaker: Platt

title: #462 – God Our Father (Jeremiah 35:14)
description: By God's grace we are His children. Let us see His commands as good for us that we may trust and obey Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #461 – Repent and Run from Sin (Jeremiah 34:11)
description: Our sin is so pervasive. We need Jesus every moment of every day. May God help us to flee sin and run to Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #460 – Confident in Christ Forever (Jeremiah 33:20–22)
description: Christ's sacrifice on the cross seals your union with Him forever and ever. He is our King and our Great High Priest.
speaker: Platt

title: #459 – Nothing is too Hard for God (Jeremiah 32:17)
description: God is sovereign over all, and nothing is too hard for Him. He will bring about salvation among all the peoples of the earth.
speaker: Platt

title: #458 – A New Covenant in Christ (Jeremiah 31:34)
description: Wherever you find yourself, you have the privilege of knowing God through Jesus. He remembers our sins no more.
speaker: Platt

title: #457 – No Longer Slaves to Sin (Jeremiah 30:8–9)
description: Christ has liberated us from the yoke of sin and has burst its bonds by standing in our place at the cross.
speaker: Platt

title: #456 – Our Future and Hope in Christ (Jeremiah 29:11–13)
description: God has plans for your welfare. This plan is for you to follow Christ, seeking first the kingdom of God.
speaker: Platt

title: #455 – Don't Minimize Messages of Judgment (Jeremiah 28:8–9)
description: Let's be clear when engaging the lost that judgment is coming, but peace is possible in Christ. God, please help the gospel not to be far from our lips.
speaker: Platt

title: #454 – Supreme Confidence (Jeremiah 27:5)
description: God is sovereign over all nations and all rulers. We have supreme confidence and complete hope in Him, knowing that one day we will be with Him forever.
speaker: Platt

title: #453 – The Whole Counsel of God (Jeremiah 26:2)
description: Jeremiah was commanded not to hold back a word. May God help us to boldly proclaim the fullness of His Word knowing that even difficult passages are for our good.
speaker: Platt

title: #452 – Jesus Drank the Cup (Jeremiah 25:15)
description: Jesus drank the cup of the wine of God's wrath due sinners. Because of Christ's work on the cross we are called the righteousness of God in Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #451 – Delight in Him (Jeremiah 24:7)
description: By God's grace we have been given a heart to know Him. May our relationship with God be marked not by religious duty, but by delighting in Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #450 – The Lord is Our Righteousness (Jeremiah 23:5–6)
description: God promised an unrighteous people that He would send a King to be their righteousness. By God's grace, in Christ, we find rest for our souls.
speaker: Platt

title: #449 – A House Built on Righteousness (Jeremiah 22:13)
description: How are you building your house? Pray that God will help your life to reflect God's compassion for the poor and needy.
speaker: Platt

title: #448 – The Way of Life (Jeremiah 21:8)
description: The way of death is sin, but in Christ we know the way of life. Through faith in Jesus, our lives are hidden with Christ in God.
speaker: Platt

title: #447 – Persecuted for Proclaiming Christ (Jeremiah 20:1–2)
description: We have brothers and sisters all over the world facing persecution. When one part of the body hurts, the whole body hurts. Let's pray for them and for their families.
speaker: Platt

title: #446 – Turn from Sin and Trust in Him (Jeremiah 19:15)
description: By God's grace through faith in Christ you can be saved. See the weight of the reality that if you do not turn from sin and trust in Him, judgment is coming.
speaker: Platt

title: #445 – Clay in the Potter's Hand (Jeremiah 18:5–6)
description: May it be our prayer for God to make us vessels for His glory knowing that He is conforming us more into the image of Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #444 – Desperately Sick and Deceitful Hearts (Jeremiah 17:9)
description: We are prone to wander and to leave the God we love. Let's pray that God will daily conform our hearts more to the heart of Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #443 – My Strength, My Stronghold, and My Refuge (Jeremiah 16:19)
description: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
speaker: Platt

title: #442 – Feed on God's Word (Jeremiah 15:16)
description: Has God's Word become a joy to you and is it the delight of your heart? Praise God that He has called us by name and may we grow in our dependence on Him through delighting in His Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #441 – We Acknowledge Our Wickedness (Jeremiah 14:20)
description: Christians must repent, confessing to God how we have sinned against Him. He is faithful and just to forgive us and cleanse us.
speaker: Platt

title: #440 – At the Root of All Our Sin (Jeremiah 13:9)
description: In a sense, pride can be found at the root of all our sin. Let's call upon God for humility in each of our lives.
speaker: Platt

title: #439 – Faithful to Forgive (Jeremiah 12:16)
description: God is gracious and merciful. Even when we sin against Him, He welcomes us to flee sin and return to Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #438 – Pray for the Persecuted (Jeremiah 11:21)
description: We have brothers and sisters all around the world who risk their lives to make the gospel known in difficult contexts. Let's pray for boldness for them and for us to proclaim Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #437 – None Like You (Jeremiah 10:6–7)
description: All nations are nothing before God. He alone is perfect in all of His glorious ways. He rules and reigns over all.
speaker: Platt

title: #436 – Boast in God (Jeremiah 9:23–24)
description: We are tempted at every turn to boast in things other than God. May we see the foolishness of this and boast only in Jesus Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #435 – My Heart is Sick (Jeremiah 8:18)
description: May we be filled with grief over those who do not know Christ and those who do not have access to the gospel.
speaker: Platt

title: #434 – The Good Life (Jeremiah 7:23)
description: We must hear God's Word and obey Him. We know that the only way for it to be well with us is to trust and obey.
speaker: Platt

title: #433 – Take Pleasure in God's Word (Jeremiah 6:10)
description: God help us to hear the clear message of judgment due sin and to rest in the finished work of Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #432 – An Appalling and Horrible Thing (Jeremiah 5:30–31)
description: It is possible for leaders in the church not to speak the Word of God and for people to love it. God, keep us from this. May we be led by Your Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #431 – The Weight of What is Coming  (Jeremiah 4:19)
description: Christians must sound the alarm and proclaim Christ because of the weight of judgment  coming for those who do not trust in Jesus.
speaker: Platt

title: #430 – Shepherds after God's Own Heart (Jeremiah 3:15–18)
description: Let's ask God for pastors who will feed the flock with the knowledge and understanding. We want pastors who will teach God's Word faithfully for the glory of Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #429 – The Fountain of Living Waters (Jeremiah 2:11–13)
description: We foolishly look to be satisfied by broken cisterns. Let's pray that God will help us to seek satisfaction only in Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #428 – God is with You (Jeremiah 1:4–8)
description: Like Jeremiah, you may feel insufficient and inadequate, but God promises that He is with you to help, deliver, strengthen, and comfort you.
speaker: Platt

title: #427 – Equipping You for His Will (Hebrews 13:20–21)
description: Call out to God who in His grace has saved you in Christ, that He will equip you to do his will and to please Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #426 – The Race Set Before Us (Hebrews 12:1–2)
description: May we look to Jesus and wage war on sin as we run the race set before us, longing to see Christ glorified in our lives.
speaker: Platt

title: #425 – He Rewards Those Who Seek Him (Hebrews 11:6)
description: The God who rules and reigns over all is the One who rewards those who seek Him. Let us long to seek God and find our reward in Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #424 – Stir Up One Another (Hebrews 10:24–25)
description: Don't approach church with a consumeristic attitude, but approach church seeking how you can help stir up others in love and good works.
speaker: Platt

title: #423 – Waiting for Him (Hebrews 9:27–28)
description: Jesus has come and paid the price for our sins. We know He is coming again so we wait for Him and work to proclaim the gospel around the world.
speaker: Platt

title: #422 – Know The Lord (Hebrews 8:11)
description: By God's grace through Christ we know Him. May we grow in our knowledge of and our love for Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #421 – Jesus Our Intercessor  (Hebrews 7:25)
description: Jesus lives to make intercession for you and me. He is dispensing the blessings of God in our lives.
speaker: Platt

title: #420 – Persevere with Faith (Hebrews 6:11–12)
description: May we call out to God knowing He will supply grace for us to patiently persevere whatever comes our way in this life.
speaker: Platt

title: #419 – Maturity in God's Word (Hebrews 5:12–14)
description: We cannot be content to drink spiritual milk like infants and not grow in our feasting on God's Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #418 – Sympathetic Resonance (Hebrews 4:14–16)
description: When we walk through temptations and trials, we have a Great High Priest who echoes our hurts and trials. We can approach His throne boldly and there find grace and mercy in our time of need.
speaker: Platt

title: #417 – Help Our Unbelief (Hebrews 3:19)
description: In the face of temptation, may we turn from sin and trust in Christ. We want to experience all that God has designed for us through faith in Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #416 – The Destruction of Death (Hebrews 2:14–15)
description: Jesus came to conquer death and has given us eternal life. We are no longer bound to the fear of death, but will be united with Christ in His resurrection.
speaker: Platt

title: #415 – He Sat Down (Hebrews 1:3)
description: The One who upholds the universe took on human flesh and lived the life we could not live. He died for sinners, ascended on high, and sat down having finished the work He came to do.
speaker: Platt

title: #414 – The Goodness of God (Leviticus 27:34)
description: God is gracious in giving us His Word. His commandments are just and right. His commands are for our good.
speaker: Platt

title: #413 – I Will Walk Among You (Leviticus 26:12)
description: In Christ, we experience joyful communion with God and have been freed to obey Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #412 – The Year of Jubliee (Leviticus 25:9–10)
description: Jesus has covered our sins and brought us from death to life. In Him we have freedom and joy. May we spread this jubilee to the ends of the earth.
speaker: Platt

title: #411 – Hallowed Be Your Name (Leviticus 24:16)
description: May we not be casual in our approach of God and let us be sensitive to ways that God's name is being misused around us.
speaker: Platt

title: #410 – Work Hard and Rest Well (Leviticus 23:3)
description: The Bible teaches that work and rest are both good and necessary. May God be honored by our work and rest.
speaker: Platt

title: #409 – Trust and Obey (Leviticus 22:20)
description: God defines what is and what is not acceptable. May we hear God's Word and obey it.
speaker: Platt

title: #408 – Honoring God's Name in This World (Leviticus 21:6)
description: What are we communicating about the nature of God to the world around us?
speaker: Platt

title: #407 – The Lord Who Sanctifies You (Leviticus 20:8)
description: Let's ask God to conform us more into the image of Christ. May we look more like Christ today than we did yesterday.
speaker: Platt

title: #406 – Love Your Neighbor as Yourself (Leviticus 19:18)
description: Think about how much we love ourselves. The revolutionary command of the Bible is to love others like that.
speaker: Platt

title: #405 – Keep My Statutes and Walk in Them (Leviticus 18:3–4)
description: We are called to worship God alone. We must be aggressive to make sure we are not accommodating our lives to look like the rest of the world.
speaker: Platt

title: #404 – Nothing But The Blood (Leviticus 17:11)
description: We deserve to die, but Jesus died in our place and we have life in Him through His blood shed for us. May we make this gospel known.
speaker: Platt

title: #403 – He Remembers Our Sins No More (Leviticus 16:21–22)
description: The price for our disobedience to God has been paid, and our sins are covered. Not only this, but through Christ our sins have been taken away.
speaker: Platt

title: #402 – Live Clean in Christ (Leviticus 15:31)
description: Are we zealous to be pure? Have we grown complacent with our sin? God, make us clean and help us to live pure before You and one another.
speaker: Platt

title: #401 – Instruments of God (Leviticus 14:1–3)
description: We must not quarantine our homes and churches of those who are viewed as unclean and outcast in the world around us. We must go to them.
speaker: Platt

title: #400 – Made Clean by Christ (Leviticus 13:45–46)
description: Christ did not avoid the leper but went to Him. Christ redeems us and makes vile sinners clean.
speaker: Platt

title: #399 – The Next Generation Knowing Christ (Leviticus 12:3)
description: Let us call out to God on behalf of families and children, that God will save kids through Christ and set them apart for His purpose.
speaker: Platt

title: #398 – Be Holy  (Leviticus 11:44–45)
description: We belong to God and have been bought with a price. God, help us not to live for our own purposes but to live set apart for the glory of Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #397 – The Severity of Sin (Leviticus 10:1–3)
description: May we pray to God, pleading for help to kill sin rather than treating it lightly.
speaker: Platt

title: #396 – Glimpsing the Glory of God (Leviticus 9:6)
description: Christ has made it possible for us to have a continual glimpse of the glory of God. May we long to see more of the glory of God in our lives.
speaker: Platt

title: #395 – A Royal Priesthood (Leviticus 8:30)
description: Jesus has made purification for sins and we are covered by His righteousness. We have access to God through Christ and we are set apart for His purpose.
speaker: Platt

title: #394 – Giving Thanks to God (Leviticus 7:11–12)
description: If we are not expressing continual gratitude to God it is likely a sure sign there is something wrong in our communion with God.
speaker: Platt

title: #393 – Sin Against Others is Sin Against God (Leviticus 6:2)
description: May we confess our sins accordingly to others and to God.
speaker: Platt

title: #392 – The Necessity of Testifying (Leviticus 5:1)
description: We are called, equipped, and empowered by the very Spirit of God to testify to the goodness of Christ and His gospel. God, help us not to sin with our silence.
speaker: Platt

title: #391 – Prone to Sin (Leviticus 4:27–28)
description: We sin in ways we do not even realize. We rejoice that God has covered our sin in Christ and ask for grace to avoid intentional and unintentional sin.
speaker: Platt

title: #390 – Giving Our Best to God (Leviticus 3:1)
description: Jesus is without blemish and uniquely qualified to save sinners. In response to this, we must live our lives for His renown.
speaker: Platt

title: #389 – A Pleasing Aroma to God (Leviticus 2:9)
description: May our lives be living sacrifices that are pleasing to God.
speaker: Platt

title: #388 – The Full and Final Sacrifice (Leviticus 1:4)
description: Leviticus points us to the need for atonement. In Christ, our sins have been atoned for, and we are welcomed into His presence.
speaker: Platt

title: #387 – Joy Comes with the Morning (Psalm 30:5)
description: God, give us grace to trust that a day is coming when our sorrow will turn to joy and we will be with You forever.
speaker: Platt

title: #385 – To You, O Lord, I Call  (Psalm 28:1)
description: If God did not hear us, we would go to hell. By God's grace, He hears us and attends to our needs.
speaker: Platt

title: #384 – We Want God (Psalm 27:4)
description: Do we primarily see God as useful? Or do we see God primarily as beautiful? We must come to God to get God.
speaker: Platt

title: #383 – The Importance of Integrity (Psalm 26:11)
description: How do we grow in integrity? By the redeeming grace of God. We need Christ to help make us people of integrity.
speaker: Platt

title: #382 – Make us Humble (Psalm 25:9)
description: The key to being led in what is right and being taught the way of God is humility.
speaker: Platt

title: #381 – Clean Hands and a Pure Heart (Psalm 24:3–4)
description: None of us can stand before God on our own merit. In Christ, we can ascend the hill of the Lord and stand in His holy place.
speaker: Platt

title: #380 – The Lord is My Shepherd (Psalm 23:1)
description: If God is our Shepherd, what else could we want?
speaker: Platt

title: #379 – Separated for Our Salvation (Psalm 22:1)
description: Jesus was forsaken on the cross to save us. He was separated from God so that we never will be.
speaker: Platt

title: #378 – The Joy of His Presence (Psalm 21:6)
description: You have unhindered access to God through Christ's work on the cross and are able to constantly commune with Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #377 – Worthy of Our Trust (Psalm 20:7)
description: Do not settle for trusting in what will only lead to despair. Trust in the One who will not put you to shame.
speaker: Platt

title: #376 – God's Word Revives the Soul (Psalm 19:7)
description: Greater than God's revelation of Himself in the world is God's revelation of Himself in His Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #375 – I Love You, O Lord, My Strength (Psalm 18:1)
description: The Sovereign King of Kings who upholds the universe and rules forever is our strength.
speaker: Platt

title: #374 – Behold His Face (Psalm 17:15)
description: We know that amid the sorrows and sufferings of this life, we can trust that a day is coming when we will see God as He is.
speaker: Platt

title: #373 – Fullness of Joy (Psalm 16:11)
description: God's plan for your life involves fullness of joy in His presence and at His right hand are pleasures forevermore.
speaker: Platt

title: #372 – Our Counselor (Psalm 16:7)
description: The God of the universe, in His Word, calls Himself our counselor.
speaker: Platt

title: #371 – In Christ Alone (Psalm 15:1)
description: Only through Jesus Christ can we be welcomed into the presence of God. In Him, we have communion with God.
speaker: Platt

title: #370 – None Who Does Good (Psalm 14:1–3)
description: We are all corrupt, but God has shown us great mercy in Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #369 – Bountiful Blessings (Psalm 13:6)
description: Ponder in your own life how God has dealt bountifully with you.
speaker: Platt

title: #368 – The Danger of Our Lips (Psalm 12:3)
description: We are tempted at every turn to boast or to use our words for evil rather than good.
speaker: Platt

title: #367 – Transcendent and Immanent (Psalm 11:4)
description: God rules and reigns over us. He is intricately involved in the very details of our lives.
speaker: Platt

title: #366 – The King of Justice (Psalm 10:17–18)
description: Let's pray that we will care for the afflicted in the way our Savior does.
speaker: Platt

title: #365 – In the Palm of His Hand (Psalm 9:20)
description: God is sovereign over all and we remember that all authorities in this world will bend the knee before Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #364 – Made in God's Image (Psalm 8:3–4)
description: The God over all creation has made you as one who reflects Him more so than anything else in creation.
speaker: Platt

title: #363 – The Righteous Judge (Psalm 7:11)
description: God feels indignation every day. Put your hope in the One who will faithfully bring forth justice.
speaker: Platt

title: #362 – My Bones are Troubled (Psalm 6:2)
description: In the middle of your languishing, know that God is gracious and good.
speaker: Platt

title: #361 – You Hear My Voice (Psalm 5:3)
description: From the time we wake up in the morning might we call out to God for His gracious leadership in our lives.
speaker: Platt

title: #360 – In Peace (Psalm 4:8)
description: Amid the chaos and hectic schedule of every day life, we can lie down in peace knowing that we belong to God.
speaker: Platt

title: #359 – The Lord Sustained Me (Psalm 3:5)
description: You woke up this morning because God sustained you. Let that transform your perspective on today and every day.
speaker: Platt

title: #358 – The Nations Belong to Him (Psalm 2:8)
description: Our prayer must be that Jesus will receive the praise He is due among every tribe and tongue. The nations are His heritage and the ends of the earth are His possession.
speaker: Platt

title: #357 – Day and Night (Psalm 1:1–2)
description: Let us be a people who meditate on God's Word day and night that we may revel in the inexhaustible truths of the glory of God.
speaker: Platt

title: #356 – The Exclusivity of Christ (John 14:6)
description: Look for an opportunity today to share with someone that Jesus is the way, the truth, and the life.
speaker: Platt

title: #355 – If You Have Love for One Another (John 13:34–35)
description: The distinguishing mark of a disciple of Christ is love for others. When we love God, we will have His love for those around us.
speaker: Platt

title: #353 – Do You Believe This? (John 11:25–26)
description: Jesus is the resurrection and the life. He has conquered sin and death. Will you take Him at His Word?
speaker: Platt

title: #352 – The Good Shepherd (John 10:10–11)
description: Jesus has laid down His life for the sheep and as a result we are given abundant life in Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #351 – Eyes to See (John 9:39–41)
description: We cannot see rightly without God. We are blind to our sin and its danger and are in desperate need of God's grace.
speaker: Platt

title: #350 – He Never Leaves Me (John 8:29)
description: By God's grace we can trust that He will never forsake us. Let's long to live every day to please Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #349 – River of Living Water (John 7:37–39)
description: In Christ's death and resurrection we are afforded the very Spirit of God. May rivers of living water flow from us today.
speaker: Platt

title: #348 – The Bread of Life (John 6:35)
description: Whoever comes to Christ will never be hungry and whoever believes in Him shall never thirst.
speaker: Platt

title: #347 – Don't Glory in Others (John 5:44–45)
description: We must value obedience to God more than the applause of men. Glorying in our Redeemer far surpasses the praise of men.
speaker: Platt

title: #346 – Lift Up Your Eyes (John 4:34–35)
description: The fields are white for harvest. Let us pray to the end that by God's grace we will take living water to the thirsty.
speaker: Platt

title: #345 – He Must Increase (John 3:30)
description: We should pray that God will help us to want people to think less about us and only about Him. Let's long to live for the increase of Christ and the decrease of ourselves.
speaker: Platt

title: #344 – His Glory Manifested (John 2:11)
description: Christ's first miracle at Cana compels us to ponder the ways in which God has manifested His glory in our lives.
speaker: Platt

title: #343 – The Right to Become Children of God (John 1:12)
description: By God's grace through faith in Christ, we have been given the right to become children of God.
speaker: Platt

title: #342 – Enter In (Exodus 40:34–35)
description: Because Jesus dwelt among us and paid the price for our sin at the cross, we are free in Him. We no longer have to stand back but can enter into the presence of the glory of God.
speaker: Platt

title: #341 – As God Commanded (Exodus 39:42–43)
description: We should long for the commentary on each of our lives to be one of obedience to the commands of God.
speaker: Platt

title: #340 – Known and Loved by God (Exodus 38:25–26)
description: We often feel as if we are merely a number in a massive world, but by God's grace we are known and loved by Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #339 – New Mercy (Exodus 37:9)
description: We are in need of the mercy of God in every aspect of our lives.
speaker: Platt

title: #338 – Generosity in the Church (Exodus 36:3–7)
description: Let us pray to the end that by God's grace we might overflow with generosity for the glory of Christ in the church and among the nations.
speaker: Platt

title: #337 – A Generous Heart (Exodus 35:5)
description: Don't you want to be described before God as one who has a generous heart?
speaker: Platt

title: #336 – A God Merciful and Gracious (Exodus 34:6–8)
description: God abounds in steadfast love for His people, forgiving us of our trespasses and sins through Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #334 – God-Ordained Intercession (Exodus 32:14)
description: We must be on our knees calling out to God for His gospel to penetrate the unengaged and unreached people groups of the world.
speaker: Platt

title: #333 – Gifts by Grace (Exodus 31:1–6)
description: God has gifted all of His people to play all kinds of different roles in glorifying Him throughout the world.
speaker: Platt

title: #332 – Make Me Clean (Exodus 30:21)
description: We are plagued by sin and faced with temptation at every turn. We need Jesus to make us clean.
speaker: Platt

title: #331 – Set Apart for God's Purposes (Exodus 29:21)
description: By the blood of Christ, we enter into the presence of God. In Christ, we are distinct from the world and must pray to the end that God will help us live for His glory.
speaker: Platt

title: #330 – Guide Our Hearts (Exodus 28:30)
description: When faced with decisions in all of life, God invites us as His people to ask Him to guide our hearts.
speaker: Platt

title: #329 – Specific Instructions (Exodus 27:1)
description: We are to worship God in accordance with what He has prescribed in His Word.
speaker: Platt

title: #328 – Mercy Made Known (Exodus 26:33–34)
description: Let us pray for family members, friends, co-workers, and any people in our sphere of influence that the mercy of God might be made known in their lives through Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #327 – Meeting with God by Mercy (Exodus 25:22)
description: We can approach the mercy seat of God only because of Christ's finished work. He has made a way for sinners to experience the presence of God.
speaker: Platt

title: #326 – The Presence of God (Exodus 24:17–18)
description: Christ has made a way for sinners to access God. We can constantly commune with God because of Christ's work.
speaker: Platt

title: #325 – Pray for Patience (Exodus 23:29–30)
description: We are prone to impatience and discontentment so we must ask God for grace that we might not lean on our own understanding.
speaker: Platt

title: #324 – Orphans, Sojourners, and Widows (Exodus 22:21–22)
description: God has ordained for His church to care for these groups of people. We must seek out ways to love orphans, sojourners, and widows.
speaker: Platt

title: #323 – The Law That Leads to Life (Exodus 21:1)
description: God gives us His Word that leads to life, so it is good and right for us to listen to His law and obey it.
speaker: Platt

title: #322 – Fear That Marks Our Lives (Exodus 20:20)
description: When we trust in Jesus to forgive us from our sins, we no longer need to fear the judgment of God. At the same time, our relationship with God is designed to be marked by love, reverence, and awe which leads us away from doing anything that would ...
speaker: Platt

title: #321 – Treasured Possession (Exodus 19:5–6)
description: For believers, God treasures us as His children, and we belong to Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #320 – A Plurality of Leaders (Exodus 18:23)
description: The biblical precedent for leadership in the church is that it is immensely valuable to have a plurality of leaders.
speaker: Platt

title: #319 – We Need Community (Exodus 17:12)
description: None of us are called to live the Christian life in isolation.
speaker: Platt

title: #318 – The Gracious Provision of God (Exodus 16:19–20)
description: Might we pray to the end that God will help us to trust in His provision day by day.
speaker: Platt

title: #317 – The Lord is My Strength and Song (Exodus 15:2)
description: We should be infused with praise in response to God's grace in our lives.
speaker: Platt

title: #316 – The Lord Will Fight for You (Exodus 14:14)
description: When we find ourselves at a dead end like the people of God in Exodus 14, we can rest assured that as God fights for us.
speaker: Platt

title: #315 – God's Loving Guidance (Exodus 13:21–22)
description: As a follower of Christ, you have the Spirit of God in you.
speaker: Platt

title: #314 – Be Faithful to Pass Down Faith (Exodus 13:8)
description: We have a responsibility to get the gospel to the next generation. Let us pray that God will give us grace to be faithful in this.
speaker: Platt

title: #313 – Christ Our Passover Lamb (Exodus 12:13)
description: In Christ, the wrath of God passes over us because it has been poured out on Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #312 – The Lord Gave Favor (Exodus 11:3)
description: Only God can give us favor. Let us be on our knees praying to him day and night for favor from God for His glory.
speaker: Platt

title: #310 – Zealous for His Name to be Known (Exodus 9:16)
description: God raises up workers for the spread of His renown to the ends of the earth.
speaker: Platt

title: #309 – Pleading in Prayer (Exodus 8:13)
description: May we never pray like it is just religious routine. God hears your cries and is working all things according to the counsel of His will.
speaker: Platt

title: #308 – One God Who Reigns (Exodus 7:5)
description: God is worthy of the praise of every person on the planet. The glory of God will cover the earth as the waters cover the sea.
speaker: Platt

title: #307 – The Promises of God (Exodus 6:6–8)
description: You can trust God. He has shown time and time again that He always delivers on His promises.
speaker: Platt

title: #306 – Long-term Good and Glory (Exodus 5:22–23)
description: Obedience to God may lead to worse circumstances in the short-term.
speaker: Platt

title: #305 – Is it not I, the Lord? (Exodus 4:10–12)
description: God never calls us to something that He does not equip us to do.
speaker: Platt

title: #304 – I Will be with You (Exodus 3:11–12)
description: Our comfort rests not in who we are but in God. Apart from Him we can do nothing.
speaker: Platt

title: #303 – The God Who Hears and Helps (Exodus 2:23)
description: The Bible teaches us that we can call out to God and rest assured that He hears our cries.
speaker: Platt

title: #302 – Never Forget God's Faithfulness (Exodus 1:8)
description: We must remember God's faithfulness towards us to fuel our trust in Him now and in the future.
speaker: Platt

title: #301 – God Meant it for Good (Genesis 50:19–20)
description: In the middle of a world filled with evil and sin, God is working for good.
speaker: Platt

title: #296 – Always at Work (Genesis 45:5)
description: Even through times that seem pointless and only hurtful, God is always working and His plans can be trusted.
speaker: Platt

title: #295 – An All-Sufficient Substitute (Genesis 44:33–34)
description: From the line of Judah came a King who stood in our place and redeemed us from the penalty of sin.
speaker: Platt

title: #293 – God's Will is Guaranteed (Genesis 42:9)
description: God's purposes cannot be thwarted and His promises will come to pass.
speaker: Platt

title: #292 – Flourishing Through Trials (Genesis 41:52)
description: In this episode of Pray the Word on Genesis 41:52, David Platt reminds Christians that God uses our hardship for good.
speaker: Platt

title: #291 – Trust During Trials (Genesis 40:8)
description: Through great tribulation, Joseph had an unwavering trust in God.
speaker: Platt

title: #290 – The Lord Was with Him (Genesis 39:2–3)
description: Joseph was comforted by the reality that God was with him. As believers we have the very Spirit of God dwelling in us.
speaker: Platt

title: #289 – Unable to Hide Sin (Genesis 38:24)
description: God knows the wickedness of your secret sin but has provided atonement through Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #288 – Bringing About Good (Genesis 37:28)
description: In the life of Joseph and throughout Scripture, we see God plotting for good even amidst tragic situations.
speaker: Platt

title: #286 – Second Chances (Genesis 35:1–3)
description: God is so gracious when we have sinned against Him; He comes to us, forgives us, and restores us to Himself.
speaker: Platt

title: #285 – Seek Revenge or Trust God as Judge (Genesis 34:25)
description: We are so tempted, when we have been treated unfairly, to seek revenge and begin a pattern of sin. But it's a whole different mindset to trust God as Judge instead.
speaker: Platt

title: #284 – Stopping Short (Genesis 33:18–20)
description: See the danger of stopping short of what God has called you to do. Let's pray that God will open our eyes to areas of our lives where we are tolerating sin.
speaker: Platt

title: #283 – God's Steadfast Love and Faithfulness (Genesis 32:9–12)
description: Like Jacob, we are unworthy of the love God has shown us, but can trust in His promises and rest in the grace that is in Him.
speaker: Platt

title: #282 – Do not Respond to Sin with Sin (Genesis 31:19-20)
description: We must have a heightened awareness of how prone we are to respond to evil with evil. We must depend on God to fight this battle.
speaker: Platt

title: #281 – Love that Endures (Genesis 29:20)
description: It is intended by God for spouses to delight in one another with love.
speaker: Platt

title: #280 – Access to God (Genesis 28:12–14)
description: In Christ, we have received a love that will not let us go. Like Jacob, we received blessing without measure.
speaker: Platt

title: #279 – Sovereign Mystery  (Genesis 27:24)
description: There is great comfort knowing that sin cannot thwart God's purposes. God is plotting for the joy of His people and the glory of His name.
speaker: Platt

title: #278 – He Will Make Your Paths Straight (Genesis 26:1–2)
description: God knows what is best for you and He will never lead you astray.
speaker: Platt

title: #277 – Infertility and the Faithfulness of God (Genesis 25:21)
description: God gives and sustains life. Amid the hurt of infertility Christians can hold fast to the truth that God is for us.
speaker: Platt

title: #276 – Marriage, Singleness, and God's Providence (Genesis 24:67)
description: Regardless of relationship status, God's Providence is good and He can be trusted that what He ordains is right.
speaker: Platt

title: #275 – Mourning with Hope (Genesis 23:2)
description: The reality of life in a fallen world is that death is certain, but followers of Christ long for the day when God will wipe away every tear from our eyes.
speaker: Platt

title: #274 – Nothing Withheld from God (Genesis 22:15–18)
description: Abraham's example of obedience exhorts Christians to entrust God with our lives.
speaker: Platt

title: #273 – He Always Fulfills His Promises (Genesis 21:1)
description: All our hopes rest in One who always delivers on His Word. We revel in this comfort.
speaker: Platt

title: #272 – Sinners to the Core (Genesis 20:12–13)
description: We are prone to all evils. We must trust in God amid temptations to compromise the truth.
speaker: Platt

title: #271 – The Wrath of God is Real (Genesis 19:24)
description: God's wrath cannot be taken lightly, but the good news of the gospel is that His mercy is afforded to those who trust in Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #270 – Heed His Warnings (Genesis 19:14)
description: God graciously warns us of the danger of sin. We must heed these warnings and flee to Christ.
speaker: Platt

title: #269 – Appealing to God's Justice (Genesis 18:25)
description: In a world of injustice, we must pray to the just Creator and Redeemer for His kingdom to come and His will to be done.
speaker: Platt

title: #268 – Is Anything too Hard for God? (Genesis 18:14)
description: This rhetorical question in Scripture reminds us how God is working all things together according to the counsel of His will.
speaker: Platt

title: #267 – Good News for the Nations  (Genesis 17:6)
description: Jesus came to save sinners, but this good news is not known among many peoples throughout the world. We must pray and we must go.
speaker: Platt

title: #266 – He Looks After You (Genesis 16:13)
description: Even in great sorrow and pain, God's Word tells us He is with us and for us.
speaker: Platt

title: #265 – Counted as Righteous (Genesis 15:6)
description: Only through faith in Christ can sinners be counted as righteous.
speaker: Platt

title: #264 – A Priest and King (Genesis 14:18–20)
description: Even in the book of Genesis, we see a picture of One who would come to redeem His people and rule and reign forever.
speaker: Platt

title: #263 – Don't Flirt with Sin (Genesis 13:12–13)
description: Far too often we toy with sin rather than fleeing from it.
speaker: Platt

title: #262 – God's Blessing is not Just for You (Genesis 12:3)
description: God's blessing did not stop with Abraham, and the same is to be true of the Christian. God's blessing is intended to spread through His people.
speaker: Platt

title: #261 – The Danger of Disobedience (Genesis 11:2–4)
description: We must give attention to our tendencies to disobey and be selective with God's commands.
speaker: Platt

title: #260 – Praying for People Groups (Genesis 10:5)
description: A day is coming when people from every tribe and tongue will surround the throne of God in praise. This drives our prayer.
speaker: Platt

title: #259 – The Pervasiveness of Sin (Genesis 9:20–21)
description: Sin is always an issue. We are constantly facing temptation so we long for the day when we will be freed from the presence of sin.
speaker: Platt

title: #258 – The Sign of the Covenant (Genesis 9:16)
description: God has given a visible picture that reminds the people of God of His covenant.
speaker: Platt

title: #257 – Great is Thy Faithfulness (Genesis 8:21-22)
description: God is sustaining all of creation and will continue to do so until the new heavens and the new earth.
speaker: Platt

title: #256 – All That God Commanded (Genesis 7:5)
description: God knows what is best for us. In light of this, we must obey all that He has commanded.
speaker: Platt

title: #255 – God's Covenant (Genesis 6:17–18)
description: Amid judgment, we see a picture of God's faithfulness in providing protection for His people from the wrath that is deserved.
speaker: Platt

title: #254 – The Grievance of God (Genesis 6:5–6)
description: We all know the world is not as it should be, but sin and its effects are not just external. We are all plagued to the core and need a new heart.
speaker: Platt

title: #253 – Walk with God (Genesis 5:24)

title: LIVE FROM HOUSTON | The Fear of God
description: Somewhere along the way, we became comfortable with a God we were never meant to make common.  He is loving, but He is still HOLY. He is near, but He is still WORTHY OF REVERENCE. He calls us friends, but He is still KING.  The fear of God isn’t being afraid of Him—it’s living with such an awareness of who He is that His presence changes how we live.
speaker: PAM

title: LIVE FROM NASHVILLE | The Heaviness of Holiness
description: Street Preachers is live from Nashville as we continue walking through 1 Peter 1:13–14 and wrestle with the heaviness of holiness.  Peter calls believers to prepare their minds, stay sober-minded, and refuse to be shaped by the desires that defined who they used to be. Holiness isn’t just about what we stop doing—it’s about who we’re becoming.  In a culture that tells us to follow every desire, Jesus calls us to a different way. There is a weight that comes with carrying His name, but there is also freedom in becoming more like Him.  Holiness isn’t the burden of following Jesus—it’s the evidence that He’s changing us.  Recorded live in Nashville on the Street Preachers Podcast Tour.
speaker: PAM

title: A  Word of Encouragement
description: Following Jesus was never promised to be easy—but it was promised to be worth it.  As we continue walking through 1 Peter, this episode is a word of encouragement for anyone navigating pressure, opposition, uncertainty, or weariness. Peter reminds believers scattered in hostile territory that hardship does not mean God has abandoned you, and resistance does not mean you’re on the wrong road.  Stand firm. Keep your heart anchored. Don’t allow what’s happening around you to change what God is doing within you.  You were chosen for this moment, strengthened for this season, and called to keep going.  Street Team, this one is for anybody who needed a reminder: don’t quit in the middle of what God is using to form you.
speaker: PAM

title: This Is Temporary
description: What do you do when following Jesus gets costly?  As we continue walking through 1 Peter, we’re reminded that persecution, pressure, rejection, and suffering have always been part of the story of God’s people—but they never get the final word.  Peter writes to believers who are scattered, misunderstood, and facing real opposition, yet he keeps pointing them beyond what they’re experiencing to what God has promised. The pressure may be real, but it’s temporary. The opposition may be loud, but it’s temporary. The suffering may hurt, but this is temporary.  In Episode 8, we talk about how to remain faithful when culture pushes back, why suffering doesn’t mean God has abandoned you, and how an eternal perspective changes the way you endure temporary pain.  Don’t let a temporary season make you question an eternal promise.
speaker: PAM

title: Concerning this Salvation
description: What if the greatest threat to this generation isn’t artificial intelligence… but artificial faith?   As we continue our journey through 1 Peter, we at a pivotal text where Peter reminds us of a salvation so extraordinary that the prophets searched for it and even angels long to understand it.  In this episode, we discuss the rapid rise of AI, welcome MG The Mortgage Guy to talk about InvestFest, and wrestle with one timeless question: What matters most in a world obsessed with what’s next?  Technology may shape the future, but only the Gospel secures eternity.
speaker: PAM

title: In This You Rejoice
description: Joy isn’t the absence of suffering—it’s the evidence of salvation.  In this episode of Street Preachers, we walk through 1 Peter 1:6–9 and uncover why genuine faith rejoices even in the fire. If your faith is being tested, this conversation will remind you that what God is refining today will be revealed in glory tomorrow.
speaker: PAM

title: Holy or Hollow
description: What if the greatest threat to Christianity isn’t opposition—but imitation?  In this episode of Street Preachers, Tim Timberlake and Philip Anthony Mitchell continue their journey through 1 Peter by confronting one of the greatest deceptions of our generation: a Christianity that looks authentic on the outside but lacks transformation on the inside.  We’ve become experts at curating appearances while neglecting holiness. Culture celebrates image, platforms reward performance, and too often the Church has settled for a faith that’s polished but powerless.  Peter calls believers to something radically different—not a veneer of Christianity, but a life genuinely transformed by the gospel. Together, we unpack what it means to pursue true holiness in a world obsessed with appearances and why God has never been impressed by what merely looks spiritual.  If you’ve ever wondered whether your faith is being shaped more by Jesus or by culture, this conversation is for you.  The question isn’t whether your faith is visible. The question is whether it’s real.
speaker: PAM

title: Undefiled and Unfading
description: The world is constantly trying to define you by your past, your pain, your success, or the opinions of others. But Peter reminds us that our identity is not built on temporary things. We have been born again into a living hope and given an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading.  In this episode, we continue our journey through 1 Peter and talk about what it means to live with an identity that cannot be altered by culture and a hope that cannot be diminished by circumstances.  If you’ve ever felt misunderstood, overlooked, or tempted to find your worth in things that fade, this conversation is for you.  Our culture offers labels that change. Jesus gives an identity that remains.  “To obtain an inheritance which is imperishable and undefiled and will not fade away, reserved in heaven for you.” — 1 Peter 1:4 (NASB95)
speaker: PAM

title: Hostile Territory
description: To the Street Team, scattered across cities and nations, grace and peace be multiplied to you in Christ Jesus.  As we continue our journey through the letter of Peter, we are reminded that following Christ has never promised the applause of men. The people of God have always been strangers in the world, citizens of another Kingdom, and witnesses in places that do not always welcome the truth.  In this episode, we consider what it means to live faithfully in hostile territory.  How should believers respond when they are misunderstood, opposed, or treated as outsiders? How do we stand firm without becoming bitter? And what does it look like to represent Jesus in a culture that grows increasingly resistant to Him?  Peter reminds us that suffering for Christ is not evidence of God’s absence, but often confirmation that we belong to Him.  Though the world may reject us, we have been chosen by God.  Stand firm. Do not grow weary. Continue the work entrusted to you.  “For this finds favor, if for the sake of conscience toward God a person bears up under sorrows when suffering unjustly.” — 1 Peter 2:19 NASB95  If this conversation strengthens your faith, share it with someone else and invite them into the journey.  Grace be with you all.
speaker: PAM

title: Chosen by God
description: As we continue our journey through 1 Peter, we explore one of the most humbling truths in Scripture: you are not an accident, and your faith is not the result of chance. Before you ever reached for God, He reached for you.  In a world that finds identity in performance and approval, Peter reminds believers that our security begins with God’s choice, God’s mercy, and God’s purpose.  If you’ve ever wrestled with your worth, questioned your place, or wondered if God sees you, this conversation is for you.  You may feel forgotten by people, but you have been chosen by God.  “According to the foreknowledge of God the Father…” — 1 Peter 1:2 NASB95
speaker: PAM

title: You Don’t Belong Here
description: 1 Peter 1:1–2  Have you ever felt like you don’t fit in? According to Peter, that feeling may not be a flaw—it may be a sign of your faith.  In this episode, Tim and Philip explore what it means to live as exiles in a world that isn’t our home. Discover why followers of Jesus should stop chasing acceptance, embrace their identity, and learn to stand firm in a culture moving the opposite direction.  You don’t belong to this world—you belong to Jesus.
speaker: PAM

description: Live from Miami!   In this episode, recorded live in Miami, we witnessed hundreds respond to the call of repentance as the power of the Holy Spirit fell with undeniable weight. Worship wasn’t a set—it was a surrender. Chains broke. Tears flowed. Hearts turned. And people didn’t leave the same way they came.

title: Live from Jacksonville | Street Preachers Podcast Tour | Philip Anthony Mitchell and Tim Timberlake
description: Live from Jacksonville Florida.  Jacksonville wasn’t just a stop on the tour—it was a tipping point.  We watched salvation meet people in real time. We saw bodies healed and hearts awakened. Those that walked in curious walked out hungry.  There was a fresh hunger birthed in the room—a holy dissatisfaction with surface faith and a deeper cry for the real presence of Jesus. Hands lifted, tears falling, voices breaking… not emotional hype, but genuine encounters that marked people forever.
speaker: PAM

title: Live from Philadelphia | Street Preachers Podcast Tour | Philip Anthony Mitchell and Tim Timberlake
description: Recorded live from our Philadelphia tour stop, this episode captures a room where history met hunger. Where people who came carrying weight left carrying fire. Where a city known for grit and resilience encountered the gentleness and authority of God’s presence.  We watched walls come down, prayers rise up, and a fresh resolve take hold. Not hype. Not noise. Just holy conviction and unshakable hope.  This night didn’t just stir emotions—it strengthened resolve. A deeper commitment. A steadier faith. A fight worth finishing.
speaker: PAM

title: Live from New York | Street Preachers Podcast Tour | Philip Anthony Mitchell and Tim Timberlake
description: LIVE FROM NEW YORK CITY   New York City is where this whole movement took its first breath—and on this night, it caught fire all over again. What started in a small room has turned into a hunger we could never manufacture and a momentum only the Holy Spirit could sustain.  In this episode, recorded live on our NYC tour stop, we revisit the streets where Street Preachers was born. We watched strangers turn to family, doubt turn into declaration, and a city known for noise fall quiet under the weight of God’s presence.  This night didn’t just remind us where we started—it awakened something brand new. A deeper hunger. A louder faith. A bolder obedience.  If you’ve ever wondered what revival sounds like in a city that never sleeps, press play. If you’ve ever needed proof that God can turn a moment into a movement, this is it.
speaker: PAM

title: Live from Charlotte | Street Preachers Podcast Tour | Philip Anthony Mitchell and Tim Timberlake
description: LIVE FROM CLT The Conversation on Prayer Continues  Street Team, In this episode, we pick up where we left off and press even deeper into one of our favorite topics — prayer.  From real stories to raw moments, from wrestling with God to walking with Him, we explore what prayer actually does in a person, a city, and a generation. This isn’t theory… this is practice. This is the kind of conversation that makes you pray different, think different, and live different.  If you’ve been asking God for clarity, strength, or breakthrough — this episode is for you.

title: Sacred Bonds
description: In this episode, we look back on the last two years and the lessons that shaped us. We unpack the weight and value of covenant relationships—why they can’t be taken lightly, and how they anchor us when everything else shifts. We also raise an alarm about the times we’re living in, challenging the culture to wake up, stand firm, and return to what matters most.
speaker: PAM

title: Did God Say That? | Street Preachers
description: In this episode of   The Street Preachers Podcast   ,  we tackle real questions people have been asking and put them to the test of God’s Word. We continue our journey through the book of Jude, uncovering timeless truth for modern chaos. We wrestle with the challenge of discerning God’s voice in a culture full of noise, and we talk about what it means to face adversity with integrity—holding on to faith when life pushes back the hardest.  Re-Uploaded for Episode 7
speaker: PAM

title: Don’t Forget What You Already Know
description: In this episode we’re reminded that forgetting God’s past works can be just as dangerous as denying Him in the present. In this episode, we break down the warning and the weight of remembrance—why Israel’s story matters to us today, how unbelief still destroys destiny, and what it means to truly trust the Deliverer who saves and sustains. Expect raw conversation, biblical revelation, and a challenge that’ll stir your faith for the battles ahead.
speaker: PAM

title: When Scripture Meets Culture
description: In this episode, we dive into the recent arrest of a pastor—not for preaching truth, but for corruption. We wrestle with how moments like this impact the witness of the Church and what it means when spiritual leadership is compromised. Then we continue our journey through the book of Jude—exploring how this ancient letter warns against false teachers, calls out hypocrisy, and urges us to contend for a faith that is pure, unshaken, and authentic.

title: Contend or Compromise | Street Preachers
description: In this episode, we continue walking through Jude as we talk about what it really means to contend for the faith in a culture that wants you quiet. title: A Small Letter For The Times We Are In | Street Preachers
description: In this episode of Street Preachers, Tim Timberlake and Philip Anthony Mitchell dive into the book of Jude —a short but urgent letter that speaks directly to the world we’re living in. They unpack Jude’s call to contend for the faith, expose false teachings, and remember the God who saves and judges. This isn’t just an ancient warning—it’s a word for right now.
speaker: PAM

title: Time Is Running Out! | Street Preachers
description: In this raw and urgent conversation, Tim Timberlake and Philip Anthony Mitchell pull no punches as they discuss the climate of the westernized church. From comfort over conviction to entertainment over discipleship, they unpack the dangers of a church drifting from the mission of Jesus. This isn’t a call to panic—it’s a call to wake up, rise up, and get back to the Gospel… because time is running out.
speaker: PAM
